des rang gi 'jug yul mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bya ba gang yang ma byas pa'i phyir/ stobs mtshungs/ ma grub na/ der thal/ des rang gi 'jug yul mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ dar ṭig pa'i rigs pa de yang ltar snang du bas te/ sngar rgol gyi shes pa thams cad la rang gi ngo bo la rang rig mngon sum du khas blangs nas/ rang gi ngo bo la de yin na/ de yin pas ma khyab par 'dod pa la/ bum 'dzin rtog pa rang gi ngo bo bzung rnam sogs gang la rang rig yin rtsad nas/ bzung rnam la yin na/ bum 'dzin (498) rtog pa chos can/ rang rig mngon sum du thal/ rang gi ngo bo bzung rnam la rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba 'di 'dra/ sngar rgol gyi gang ma khyab par khas blangs pa de la slar ma khyab pa shags tsam las nus pa ci yang mi snang bas so// kho bo cag bum 'dzin rtog pa sogs rang gi ngo bo la rang rig mngon sum du 'dod pa ni/ rang gi ngo bo rig bya yul dang*/ bum 'dzin rtog pa sogs rig byed yul can du byas nas rig cing*/ de yang rig bya rig byed rdzas gcig pas rang gi ngo bo la rang rig mngon sum du 'dod pa yin la/ yang bum 'dzin rtog pa de rang gi ngo bo la mngon 'gyur dang*/ rang nyid shes pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang rang gi ngo bo la ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa zhes kyang bya/ rang gi ngo bo la mngon sum zhes kyang bya ba yin te/ shes pa thams cad mthar yul can shes pa'i sgo nas rang rig mngon sum gcig pur 'du ba'i phyir/ dper na 'jug yul du gyur pa'i gzhal bya thams cad mthar 'jug gzhi'i gzhal bya rang mtshan gcig pur 'du ba bzhin no/ de skad du/ tshad ma mdor/ rtog pa'ang rang rig nyid du 'dod// don la ma yin der rtog phyir// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel la/ rang gi ngo bo sogs tshig (499) rkang gnyis dang*/ 'dir shes pa'i sgo nas rang rig gcig ces dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ dbye sgo gsum po de'ang yul can gyi sgo nas rang rig pa kho nar 'du la/

des na don thams cad rang mtshan dang*/ shes pa thams cad rang rig tu 'du'o// zhes dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bsdu na gcig ces pa'i 'grel par yang*/ tshad ma gnyis ka yang rang rig mngon sum du 'du la/ yul gnyis ka yang gzhal bya rang mtshan du 'du bar gsungs pa bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig shes pa thams cad rang rig tu 'du/ zhes pa'i tshig zin dang*/ rang rig bem po zlog tsam yin zhes pa la brten nas shes pa yin na/ rang rig yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'o na gzhal bya yin na rang mtshan yin pas khyab par thal/ don thams cad rang mtshan dang zhes gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gal te 'di'i don phyi don sogs ma yin nam snyam na/ phyi don rang mtshan gyi nang sel yin pas/ rang mtshan gyi nang sel rang mtshan du 'du mi 'du bshad pa la 'brel ci 'byung ba soms shig des na tshad mas gzhal bar bya ba'i don la 'chad dgos pa yin te/ skra bshad la sogs don min te/ zhes pa'i don dang 'jog tshul (500) gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ don thams cad rang mtshan dang zhes pa'i don dang*/ tshad ma gnyis ka yang rang rig mngon sum du 'du la yul gnyis ka yang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi yul don gcig pa'i phyir/ der ma zad/ bum 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa bshag 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ gzhan rig yin pa'i phyir te/ don rig yin pa'i phyir te/ bum 'dzin dbang mngon yin pa'i phyir/ rtog pa yang chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rang gi zhen yul la rang rig yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig zhen yul can gyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de la rang rig ma yin par thal/ de la rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ don la ma yin der rtog phyir// zhes pa la go don ci yod som zhig go don ni rtog med shes par ma zad rtog pa'ang rang gi ngo bo la rang rig mngon sum du 'dod la/ 'on kyang*/ rang gi zhen yul du gyur pa'i don la rang rig mngon sum ma yin te/

de la rtog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de la zhen blo yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'o// de ltar na don la zhes pa rang gi gzhal bar bya ba'i don de la yin gyi/ don la gnas pa'am don dang tha snyad kyi zlas phye ba'i don la 'khrul par mi bya'o// kun (501) mkhyen g.yag pas rtog pa rang gi gzung rnam la 'khrul pa dang*/ don rig mngon sum rang gi gzung rnam la ma 'khrul bar bshad pa la/ dgongs pa ni/ yul sogs sgo nas du mar 'gyur zhes pa'i 'grel par/ shes pa la ngo bo'i sgo nas 'khrul shes ma 'khrul shes gnyis su dbye ba'i ngo bo bzung rnam la mdzad nas/ de la 'khrul ma 'khrul la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'khrul shes ma 'khrul shes kyi dbye ba 'jog par dgongs pa yin no// de ni mi 'thad de/ 'o na 'dzin rnam rkyang pa can gyi rang rig mngon sum dang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum rnams ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba'i 'khrul shes sam ma 'khrul shes gang yang ma yin par 'gyur te/ de rnams rang gi gzung rnam la 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rnam gzhag med pa'i phyir te/ de rnams kyi gzung rnam med pa'i phyir/ des na/ 'di'i ngo bo ni/ shes pa rang rig gi ngo bo bzung rnam sogs ma yin gyis/ shes pa la dbye na/ yul gyi dbye ba la ma ltos par shes pa rang nyid kyi sgo nas 'khrul shes ma 'khrul shes gnyis su dbye ba la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas 'khrul shes ma 'khrul shes kyi dbye ba gnyis su mdzad pa yin no// gzhan du na 'khrul shes thams cad rang gi (502) ngo bo'i sgo nas mngon sum ma yin par 'gyur te/ 'khrul shes thams cad ngo bo'i sgo nas 'khrul shes su bzhag pa gang zhig ngo bo zhes pa rang gi ngo bo la ngos bzung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'khrul shes thams cad rang gi ngo bo la mngon sum min par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhung dang 'gal lo// de bas na/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge yab sras kyi bzhed pas/

shes pa yin na/ rang gi ngo bo la rang rig mngon sum yin pas khyab par gsungs pa ni/ mdo rnam 'grel rigs gter gsum char gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa yin no// gnyis pa rang rig pa'i don ni rang gi ldog cha nas rig bya rig byed gnyis su phye ba'i rang rig pa ma yin te/ shes pa gcig nyid la rang ldog nas rig bya rig byed kyi ldog cha gnyis 'byung ba 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'grel par rang nyid yul yin no zhe na rang la yul dang yul can 'gal lo zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de yin no// shes pa rang nyid bem po las log nas rang gi ldog cha rig par skyes tsam de nyid rang rig gi don du 'jog ste/ rgyan las rnam shes bem po'i rang bzhin las// ldog pa rab tu skye ba ste/ bem min rang bzhin gang (503) yin pa/ de 'dir bdag nyid rig pa yin/ zhes dang*/ 'dir yang*/ rang rig bem po ldog tsam yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnad kyi don ni/ shes pa thams cad kyi steng na rang gi ngo bo bem po las ldog nas myong ba gsal rig tu skyes pa'i gsal tsam rig tsam myong tsam re yod par grub cing*/ de thams cad ni rang rig mngon sum yin te/ rigs thigs las/ sems dang sems las byung ba thams cad kyi rang rig pa'o// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ rang rig mngon sum gyi tshad ma dang tshad ma min pa'i rnam par dbye ba ston par byed pa min te/ shes pa thams cad la rang rig pa yod pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pas so// rig bya rig byed mi 'byed par gsungs pa yang*/ shes pa rang gi rang ldog nas rig bya rig byed kyi ldog cha tha dad du mi 'byed pa la dgongs pa yin gyis/ rang rig mngon sum gyi rig bya dang yul mi bzhed pa ni ma yin te/ 'grel par rang mthong ba rang rig dang zhes bshad pa yang yul gzhan mthong ba don rig gnyis dang zhes tshig grogs snga ma'i shugs las/ yul rang mthong ba rang rig dang*/ zhes pa bsnyon med du gsal ba'i phyir/

gal te (504) rang rig mngon sum la yul med na/ de chos can/ khyod lta byed ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi lta bya'i yul med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lta byed yin par thal/ lta byed kyi tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'jal byed kyi tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ mngon rjes gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ khyod shes byed kyi blo ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi shes bya'i yul med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bsla/ 'di dag la khyab pa med do gsungs na/ grangs can gyi lugs srol 'dzin par 'gyur te/ rang 'grel las/ lta bya med pa'i lta byed dang*/ shes bya med pa'i shes byed 'dod pa ni grangs can gyi lugs so/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na tshad ma mdor/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /tshad ma'o mtshan nyid gnyis gzhal bya// zhes 'jal byed tshad ma gnyis dang*/ gzhal bya rang spyi gnyis sbyar nas gsungs bzhin du/ tshad ma'i nang sel rang rig mngon sum la gzhal bya dang yul med gsungs pa ni/ rigs gzhung gi grags tshod dang 'gal zhing*/ shin tu skyong dka' bas/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi bzhed srol ltar rang rig la yul yod par sgrub pa 'di blo la 'thad pa (505) yin no// gsum pa rtsod spang ni/ rang ldog nas rig bya rig byed kyi ldog cha gnyis su med kyang*/ rig na grangs can ltar rang skye dang mtshungs zhe na/ mi mtshungs te/ rang skye ni rang dus na gsal por med pa slar gsal bar skye ba tsam yin pas/ rang nyid grub pa bskyed mi dgos la/ ma grub pa bskyed mi nus pas dgos nus med la/ rang rig ni/ bem po las/ ldog nas rang nyid rig pa tsam du skyes pa la rang rig tu btags shing*/ de ni shes pa thams cad la yod pa'i phyir ro// de skad du/ rang skye sngon med skye ba yin// rang rig bem po log tsam yin// des na rang rig rang skye gnyis// mtshungs pa'i sgo skabs yod ma yin// zhes gsungs so// shes pa rang rang ngo bo myong byed la// ma 'khrul rang rig mngon sum mtshan nyid yin// shes pa thams cad rang rang ngo bo la// rang rig mngon sum yin pa phyogs glang dang*// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung gis gsal bar bstan// rang gi ngo bo gzung rnam 'dzin rnam las// gnyis snang can kun gzung rnam rig byed cing*// de la mngon 'gyur phyir na de nyid la// rang rig mngon sum yin par mkhas pas rtogs// shes kun rang rig ngo bo 'dzin rnam la// mngon 'gyur phyir

(506) dang rig byar byed pa'i phyir// de la rang rig mngon sum tha snyad thob// kha cig shes pa kun la rang rig gis// khyab par smra ba sgra zin tsam la zhen// 'o na gzhal bya kun kyang rang mtshan du// thal bar 'gyur te sgra zin mtshungs phyir ro// dpyod ldan kha cig bum 'dzin rtog pa yis// rang gi ngo bo lta bar ma byas phyir// de la blo rigs gang yang min gsungs kyang*// de yi ngo bo de la mngon 'gyur phyir// de yi ngo bo de yi snang yul grub// shes kun rang rang snang yul ma yin na// rang yul rang mtshan snang bas 'dzin pa la// rtog med shes par bshad pa 'gog rigs sam// ma pham g.yag pas rang rig yul med du// nan gyis bzhed 'di 'grel pa'i sgra zin 'gas// 'khrul gzhi'i ca co gleng kyang dngos bstan du// zhen na rigs gzhung phal gyi gnod byed 'phrog /yul gzhan phyi don mthong ba don rig dang*// rang yul shes pa mthong ba rang rig sogs// rang 'grel bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 'di bzhes na// 'khrul med gtam 'di yid ches cis mi mdzad// rang rig mngon sum bstan zin to// ༈ //bzhi pa rnal 'byor mngon sum ni/ mdo las/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa (507) zhes gsungs pa dang*/ tshad ma kun btus las/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi bla mas bstan// ma 'dres pa yis don tsam mthong*// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ rnal 'byor shes pa sngar bshad pa// de dag gi de bsgom byung yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ rang bzhin ngos bzung ba/ yul la tshad mar 'gyur ba'i tshul/ de sgrub byed kyi tshad ma'o// dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rgyu bsam pa dang gsum/ dang po la gnyis las/ gzhan lugs ni/ snga rabs pa kha cig rnal 'byor mngon sum dang*/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi tshad ma gnyis so sor phye nas mtshan nyid tha dad du 'jog pa ni mi 'thad de/

gnyis su 'byed pa gzhung las ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa las byung ba'i rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ rnam mkhyen skad cig ma gnyis pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa las 'byung bar thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod (508) na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi snga logs de ma thag tu yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig khyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yin na/ khyod kyi snga logs de ma thag pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen skad cig ma dang po'i dus na yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen skad cig ma dang po'i dus na nyams len yod par thal lo// yang rang gi bdag rkyen yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa las byung ba'i rtog bral ma 'khrul pa'i rig pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid la 'jog na yang sngar gyi des ma nges te/ de'i bdag rkyen yin yin na de'i snga logs de ma thag pa yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ de'i bdag rkyen yin na de'i dngos rgyu yin dgos pa'i phyir/ phyis kyi rnam bshad kha cig na re/ yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa las byung ba'i 'khrul med kyi shes pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin gsungs pa yang mi 'thad de/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa las byung ba gang zhig ma 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ yang dag pa'i don la

(509) bsgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i thar lam yin pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ mngon sum yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen yang dag pa'i don la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas skyes shing*/ yang dag pa'i don la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ bsgom byung 'khrul med mngon sum ste// 'khrul pa can rnams ltar snang yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor mngon sum ltar snang ni yid shes 'khrul pa yin zhing*/ mtshan gzhi ni/ snang ba thams cad keng rus su bsgom pa la brten nas snang ba de ltar shar ba'i shes pa de yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ mi gtsang zad par sa la gsos// yang dag min pa'ang bsgom pa yi// stobs kyis sprul pa rtog med dang*// gsal bar snang ba can du mthong*// zhes dang*/ lhag ma nye bar bslad pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi don ni/ (510) bsgom byung gi ye shes la rnal 'byor du byas nas/ der gyur pa'i mngon sum la rnal 'byor mngon sum mam/ rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum zhes bya ba yin te/ rang 'grel las/ rnal 'byor gyi shes pa tsam gyis mtshan nyid ni bsgoms pa'i stobs las snang ba yin no// rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid ni bsgoms pa las byung ba ma 'khrul ba'i shes rab bo// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rigs thig las/ yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa'i rab kyi mtha' las byung ba rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa'o// zhes dang*/ lha'i 'grel par yang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum zhes bshad kyang 'gyur byed lo tsā ba'i skyon las 'os med de/

sgra ji bzhin yin na/ rnal 'byor pa'i dbang mngon chos can/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin par thal/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa song ste/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum la rnal 'byor mngon sum du khyed rang gis bzhag pa'i phyir/ des na bsgom byung 'khrul med ces pa'i dngos bstan gyis bsgom byung ni/ rnal 'byor dang*/ bsgom byung der gyur pa'i mngon sum ni rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pas rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum zhes gzhi mthun gyi bsdu ba yin no// rang 'grel gyi tshig zin las/ shes rab mtshan nyid kyi zur du (511) smos pa ni bden bzhi mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab rnal 'byor mngon sum du song ba na/ de'i stobs las de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung gzhan rnams kyang rnal 'byor mngon sum du 'gro bas shes rab gtso che ba la dgongs pa yin te/ dper na chos mngon par/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa 'jog pa na zag med kyi shes rab gtso bor smos pa bzhin no// des na yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa las byung ba'i bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid du bzhag na yang 'gal ba med cing legs pa yin te/ rang 'grel gyi tshig rigs de'i phyir ro// gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis te/ rten dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos 'phags pa/ rang rgyal 'phags pa/ theg chen 'phags pa gsum gyi rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum gsum/ de la slob mi slob kyi sgo nas phye na rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs pa'i nyan thos slob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum/ nyan thos mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum/ rang sangs rgyas la slob pa med pas/ de'i mngon sum mi bzhed pa'i phyir/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rnal (512) 'byor mngon sum gcig theg chen slob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnal 'byor la mngon sum/

theg chen mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum dang lnga ste/ 'phags pa gsum gyi mngon sum gsum// slob dang mi slob sgo nas lnga// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam thams cad cig car du bsgrod pa'i tshul ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten sbyor lam drod nas bzung*/ mi slob lam gyi bar sbyor lam bzhi/ mthong lam bcu drug bsgom lam bar chad med lam dgu// rnam 'grol lam dgu/ mi slob lam dang bcas pa'i lam thams cad rjes thob kyi bar ma chod par mnyam gzhag thun gcig la stan thog gcig tu bsgrod pa yin te/ ston dang bse ru byang chub bar// bsam gtan mtha' rten gcig la kun// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa rnams ni rang rgyal ma yin te/ nyan thos yin pa'i phyir ro// shar gyi ri bo'i sde pa dang*// nub kyi ri bo'i sde pa la sogs pa'i nyan thos 'ga' zhig byang chub sems dpa' ni 'khor ba las ma grol bas byang sems su gyur pa'i 'phags pa mi 'dod cing*/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum (513) mi 'dod la/ mdzod kyi grub mtha' bzhin skyong ba'i bye brag smra bas ni byang sems 'phags pa mnyam gzhag pa khas len te/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ byang sems kyi mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug dang*/ bsgom lam dgu tshan gnyis te skad cig ma sum cu rtsa bzhi'i bar ma chod du skye bar 'dod pa gang zhig de ltar skyes pa'i tshe na rten gyi gang zag de byang sems 'phags pa las 'os med pa'i phyir/ nyan thos mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum la shes rab rkyang pa'i cha las rnam grol dang*/ shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba'i nyan thos mi slob pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum dang gnyis yod/ shes rab rkyang pa'i cha las rnam grol ni nyon sgrib tsam spangs nas ngos skal gyi snyom 'jug gi sgrib pa ma spangs pa'i nyan thos mi slob pa dang*/

gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol ni nyon sgrib dang*/ ngos skal gyi snyom 'jug gi sgrib pa gnyis ka spangs pa'i nyan thos mi slob pa de yin te/ rim bzhin/ 'gog pa'i snyom 'jug thob pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang*/ ma thob pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa lta bu'o// de skad du/ 'gog thog gnyis ka las rnam grol// shes rab kyis ni gcig shos (514) so// zhes gsungs so// theg pa chen po pa 'ga' zhig nyan thos la chos kyi bdag med mthong ba'i ye shes med pas nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud la rnal 'byor mngon sum mtshan nyid pa med do zhes kyang 'dod pa byung la/ 'di'i ngos 'dzin ni glo bo mkhan chen gyis dbu ma thal 'gyur ba 'ga' zhig la mdzad do// 'dir dpal chos kyi grags pas/ 'phags pa lnga ka la rnal 'byor mngon sum bzhed pa ni/ mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' dang bstun te bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i ye shes la rnal 'byor mngon sum du bzhag pa'i gnad kyis yin te/ bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba ni 'phags pa lnga ka la yod pa'i phyir ro// des na 'dir rnal 'byor mngon sum yin na chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas ma khyab la/ bden bzhi'i chos nyid rtogs pas khyab pa yin no// gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'phags pa lnga'i rnal 'byor mngon sum de dag ni kun rdzob kyi snang cha dang bcas pa'i snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum dang*/ snang cha de med pa'i snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum gnyis gnyis su dbye bas bcur 'gyur te/ de dag snang bcas snang med kyi// dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bcu// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos slob pa'i snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon (515) sum ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob la ma nyams pa'i nyan thos slob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mngon par shes pa lnga dang*/ nyan thos mi slob pa'i snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum yang gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi mngon par shes pa lnga la 'jog cing*/

gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes des stong gnyis bar ma dang*/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi lha'i mig gi mngon shes des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten dang*/ byang sems 'phags pa'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes des/ sa bcu'i rim pas 'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang stong dang 'bum la sogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lha'i mig gi mngon shes des 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa'i gzugs nye ring che chung thams cad mthong*/ de bzhin du/ de dag gi lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes de dang des kyang rim pa bzhin sngar bshad pa ltar gyi 'jig rten gyi khams de dang de na yod pa'i sgra nye ring che chung thams cad thos pa yin te/ mdzod las/ dgra bcom bse ru ston rnams kyis// stong gnyis gsum dang grags med mthong*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ rang 'grel las/ (516) snang bcas la nyan thos kyi slob pa ni bsam gtan gyi sems thob na mngon par shes pa 'char la ma thob na mi 'char zhing*/ mi slob pa'ang shes rab kyi cha las rnam par grol ba la mngon par shes pa lnga med la/ gnyis ka'i cha la rnam grol dang rang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyis rim pa bzhin stong gnyis gsum dang grangs med kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams mthong ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no// bsam gtan gyi sems thob na mngon shes 'char la ma thob na mi 'char ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir mngon shes yin na/ bsgom pa las byung bas khyab cing*/ de'i nang nas kyang bsam gtan bsgom pa'i zhi gnas la brten nas bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa na mngon par shes pa mtshan nyid pa 'char la/ ma thob na mngon shes su ming btags kyang mngon shes ma yin te/ rten gyi gang zag de 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral bas so// 'dis 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i rgyun zhugs dang*/

phyir 'ong rnams la snang bcas/ rnal 'byor mngon sum med par bstan pa yin no// mdzod las/ mngon shes rnam drug rnam grol blo// zhes dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mngon shes drug gsungs pa las 'grel pa 'dir mngon shes lnga las (517) drug gi gsal kha mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ rang gi bsam tshod spyir mngon shes drug gi bshad tshod yod kyang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum du 'gyur ba'i lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang lnga char zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes nyid yin pas/ mngon par shes pa lnga smos pas chog pa la dgongs pa yin no// 'dir dogs pa 'di 'byung ste/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i lha'i mig gis mngon shes chos can/ rnal 'byor mngon sum ma yin par thal/ dbang shes yin pa'i phyir te/ mig shes yin pa'i phyir te/ mig gi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mig gi mngon par shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes la yang 'gre'o zhe na/ lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon par shes pa yin na/ mig dang rna ba'i shes pa yin pas ma khyab te/ dper brjod na/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon par shes pa yin na/ gzhan sems shes pa'i shes pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ so skye'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes mtha' dag gis ma nges so// yang 'phags rgyud kyi lha'i mig gi (518) mngon shes sogs chos can/ dbang shes ma yin par thal/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa la brten pa'i shes pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir te/

'phags rgyud kyi mngon shes yin pa'i phyir/ spyir mngon shes mtha' dag rgyu bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bsgom pa las byung zhing*/ ngo bo dge ba de'ang shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshungs ldan yin pas dbang shes dang mngon shes kyi gzhi mthun yod pa yang dka' ste/ dbang shes yin na lung ma bstan dang*/ mngon shes yin na dge ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ bstan bcos rab tu byed pa las/ mngon par shes pa gang zhe na shes rab dge ba'o// zhes gsungs so// kha che bye brag smra bas mngon shes dang po gnyis lung ma bstan du 'dod kyang*/ mngon shes rnam drug rnam grol blo/ zhes mngon shes drug char rnam grol lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i shes rab kyi rang bzhin du bshad pa dang nang 'gal te/ kho rang gi grub mtha'i rang skyon yin no// snang (519) med rnal 'byor mngon sum ni// bdag med rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas 'byed pa yin te/ nyan thos pa'i slob pa'i snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum des/ kun btags kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs/ nyan thos mi slob pa'i des lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs/ rang sangs rgyas kyi des de'i steng du bzung ba chos kyi bdag med kyang rtogs pas bdag med phyed dang gnyis rtogs/ byang sems 'phags pas de'i steng du 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med yang rtogs pas bdag med gnyis ka yongs su rdzogs pa rtogs/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ kun brtags kyi bdag gi ngos 'dzin ni/ grangs can gyis brtags pa'i khyad par lnga ldan gyi bdag dang*/ nyan thos mang bskur ba'i brtags pa'i phung po dang rdzas gcig pa'i bdag sogs la bya zhing*/ de dag rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa ni/ kun brtags kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i tshad du 'jog rtogs byed kyi lam des spangs pa'i spang bya mthong spang la yang spang bya kun brtags dang gzhi med ces bya la/

de bzhin du 'jig rten lhan skyes pas brtags (520) pa'i gang zag rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni brtag pa mtha' bzung gi lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag gi ngos 'dzin dang*/ gang zag de bden med dam rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa na lhan skyes kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa dang*/ rtogs byed kyi lam des spangs pa'i spang bya bsgom spang la yang spang bya lhan skyes dang gzhi bcas zhes bya/ rang sangs rgyas kyis de'i steng du bzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden med du rtogs pas bzung ba chos kyi bdag med gtan la phabs te phyi don bden par med pa sems tsam rnam bden pa dang thun mong ba'i skabs dang*/ byang sems 'phags pas de dag gi steng du yul 'dzin byed kyi shes pa bzung rnam bden med du rtogs pas 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med gtan la phabs cing*/ bzung rnam sgro btags su 'dod pa sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i skabs bzhin mdzad pa rnam 'grel dang*/ rigs gter gyi mthar thug gi lta ba rnam rdzun du bzhed pa la dgongs pa yin te/ shes bya nang la bzhugs pa na zhes sogs dang mthun no// de skad du/ rang 'grel las/ bdag med dbye ba 'di theg pa thun mong gi yin gyi/ nyan thos dang theg pa chen po 'ga' zhig 'phags pa gsum la bdag med rtogs pa'i khyad

(521) par mi 'dod de/ bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid dam chos thams cad bdag med par ma rtogs na bden pa mthong ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang mchog dman gyi khyad par ni snying rje dang thabs kyi bye brag la ltos par 'dod do// zhes gsungs so// de la bden bzhi'i chos nyid ma rtogs par bden mthong mi 'dod pa ni tshad ma smra ba'i mdo sde pa'i bzhed pa'i gtso bo dang*/ chos thams cad bden med du ma rtogs par bden mthong mi 'dod pa ni theg pa chen po'i yang rtse smra ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa yin/ rang rang gi gzhung du de ltar gsal ba'i phyir dang*/ thub pa dgongs gsal du yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas rigs can gsum la bdag med rtogs pa'i khyad par mi bzhed pa 'di dang 'dra bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rgyu bsam pa la gsum las/ dang po ye shes gnyis kyi rgyu ni/ shes rab kyis nyer len dang*/ thabs kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas ji lta ba'i ye shes dang*/ thabs kyis nyer len dang*/ shes rab kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas ji snyed pa'i ye shes 'grub pa yin te/ thabs dang shes rab legs sbyangs pa// phan tshun rgyu dang rkyen gyur pa// ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i// ye shes gzigs pa 'grub par (522) 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// 'di'i ye shes gnyis ni/ sangs rgyas sa'i snang bcas dang snang med mngon sum du gsal lo// gnyis pa rnal 'byor mngon sum de dag mthar phyin pa'i dus ni/ nyan thos brtson 'grus myur bas tshe gsum gyis bsod nams dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med bsgom pas nyan thos dgra bcom thob pa na/ nyan thos kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum mthar phyin/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can brtson 'grus myur bas bskal pa brgyar sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes pa sogs kyis bsod nams dang bdag med phyed dang gnyis bsgom pas rang rgyal thob pa na de'i rnal 'byor mngon sum mthar phyin/

byang sems brtson 'grus myur zhing dbang po rno bas bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis rgya chen po goms pas sangs rgyas thob pa na theg chen gyi rnal 'byor mngon sum mthar phyin pa yin te/ theg pa rang rang gi mthar thug gi 'bras bu thob pa la de dang de'i rnal 'byor mngon sum mthar phyin par 'jog pas so// 'di ni/ tshe gsum bskal pa brgya dang ni// grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin// zhes pa'i don no// paṇa chen gyis/ nyan rang la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bshad kyang*/ bsod nams dang bsod nams kyi tshogs (523) kyi khyad par sogs ma phye ba yin te/ nyan rang la bsod nams dang ye shes bshad kyi/ de gnyis kyi tshogs ma bshad pa'i phyir te/ lam tshogs gnyis dang 'bras bu sku gnyis ni theg chen gyi khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel par bskal pa brgya'i tshogs dang zhes pa ni/ bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge rtsa kun tshogs spyi tsam par 'jog pa'i skabs de yin pas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang 'khrul pa mi bya'o// gsum pa thabs la ltos nas 'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ nyan rang gis rgyu'i dus su thabs la legs par ma sbyangs pas/ da lta thugs mi gsal zhing nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ma spangs pas shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa ma yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis rgyu'i dus su thabs la yun ring goms pas da lta thugs gsal zhing*/ bag chags dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa spangs pas shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po// yun ring dus su goms pa las// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di ni thabs zhan pas na rnam grol gnyis/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad kyi don no// thabs mang zhes pa'i mang tshig gis// brtse ba snying rje chen po thabs spyi dang*/ bsam (524) gtan dang*/ smon lam dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa thabs kyi bye brag kun bstan pa yin te/ theg chen gyi spyod pa'i cha rnams thabs dang*/

lta ba'i cha rnams shes rab kyi phyogs su 'jog dgos pa dpyod ldan gyis mthong ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa yul la tshad mar 'gyur ba'i tshul la gsum las/ dang po rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum thams cad tshad mar bsgrub pa ni/ bod snga rabs pa rnams/ rnal 'byor mngon sum dang bcad shes kyi gzhi mthun 'dod cing*/ de tshad mar 'jog pa la 'jug yul nges pa dgos te/ tshad mar 'jog pa la myong stobs kyis sgro 'dogs gcod dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba de 'gog par bzhed nas/ bcad shes dang ni nges pa gnyis// rtog pa yin phyir mngon sum min// des na rnal 'byor mngon sum kun// mngon sum yin phyir tshad mar grub// ces gsungs te/ don ni/ bcad shes dang nges pa gnyis chos can/ khyod dang mngon sum gyi gzhi mthun srid pa ma yin te/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na rnal 'byor mngon sum kun chos can/ rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren nus mi nus dpyad par bya yi tshad ma yin min dpyad par bya ba min te/ mngon sum yin pa'i phyir na tshad mar grub pa gzhir bzhag pas so// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa tshad (525) ma des 'jug ldog byed pa'i tshul ni/ 'o na rnal 'byor mngon sum gyis// rang gi 'jug yul ma nges na rang yul la 'jug ldog byed pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro zhe na/ spyir rnal 'byor mngon sum rgyud la mi ldan pa'i so so skye bo'i tshad ma rnams ni rang gi 'jug yul la rang stobs dang gzhan stobs gang rung gi sgo nas nges pa drangs nas 'jug ldog byed la/ 'phags pa rtog pa'i bag chags ma spangs pa nyan rang dang*/ ma dag sa bdun la gnas pa rnams rjes thob rang bzhin du gnas pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi dbang mngon dang rnal 'byor mngon sum dang rjes dpag sogs kyi tshad ma mtha' dag so skye'i tshad ma dang 'dra bar 'jug ldog byed la/ smon nas shes pa'i ting 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa na rang rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum rnams rang yul la ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis 'jug ldog byed/

rtog pa'i sa bon spangs pa dag pa sa gsum gyi byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum rnams dpa' bar 'gro ba dang*/ rin chen phyag rgya la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can gyi stobs kyis rang yul la 'jug ldog byed pa yin te/ so so skye bo'i tshad ma ni zhes sogs tshig bcad gsungs pa 'di la lung khungs zhig yod snang ba (526) sngon gyi mchan rnying sogs las btsal bar bya'o// gsum pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes dpyad pa ni/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis 'das ma 'ongs mi mkhyen na shes bya kun mkhyen par mi rung la/ mkhyen na 'das ma 'ong gi rnam pa snang nas mkhyen dgos la/ de ltar na dus gsum rdzas su grub par 'gyur ro zhe na/ sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyi dus gsum mkhyen tshul sogs so so skye bo'i blos dpag par mi nus te/ ma dag pa'i snang cha 'di kun dag pa'i snang bar gnas gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes brnyes pa can yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ rnam 'grel las/ rnal 'byor rtogs pa bsam mi khyab ces dang*/ 'dir yang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes can// de yi mkhyen pa dpag mi nus// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa rnal 'byor mngon sum sgrub byed kyi tshad ma la gsum ste/ ngo bo sgrub pa/ mtshan nyid sgrub pa/ grub pa'i don la mi 'thad pa spangs pa'o// dang po la gnyis las/ 'das pa sgrub pa ni/ gang tshig gi khyad par dpyad gsum gyis dag pa nyid du nges par gyur na sngon byung zin pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum yang dpag par nus te/ rtags sbyor du bkod na/ gang rang gi brjod bya ston pa la dpyad gsum gyis rnam par dag pa'i tshig khyad par can yin na rang gi (527) brjod don rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum sngon du song bas khyab/ dper na gzhung 'chad pa po tshad ldan gyi bshad pa'i rang rang gi gzhung bzhin sher phyin gyi gzhung bka' brgyad stong pa yang rang gi brjod don ston pa la dpyad gsum gyis rnam par dag pa'i tshig khyad par can yin no// zhes pa lta bu'o// 'di ni dpyod pa pa sogs rnal 'byor mngon sum mi 'dod pa'i log rtog gi gnyen por yin pas rnal 'byor mngon sum nyid sgrub byed kyi rigs pa'o// 'di ni rnam 'grel las/

yid ches tshig ni mi bslu ba'i// spyi las 'di yul lkog gyur na'ang*// zhes pa des don gyis bstan zhing*/ 'dir tshig gi khyad par nges gyur na/ sngon byung ba'ang dpag par nus// zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa ma 'ongs pa 'byung ba sgrub pa ni/ gang rten brtan zhing khyad par du 'gyur ba bsgom pa yin na/ goms pa rdzogs goms bya'i don de la gsal snang 'byung bas khyab/ dper na 'dod 'jigs goms pa'i blo bzhin stong nyid bsgom pa'i blo yang de yin no// zhes pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtags sbyor 'di rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi rgyu la log rtog gi gnyen por yin te/ rgyang 'phen pa rnams skye ba snga phyi mi 'dod pas stong (528) pa nyid dang snying rje rnams skye ba du mar yun ring du goms pa mi 'dod pa de bkag nas/ de dag yun ring du gom pa las gom bya'i don la gsal snang 'byung ba sgrub ste/ rgyu tshogs grangs tshang gi rtags las 'bras bu rnal 'byor mngon sum 'byung ba'i sgrub byed du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de yang rnam 'grel las/ gang gang shin tu gom gyur pa// bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa na// de gsal mi rtog blo 'bras can/ zhes dang*/ 'dir yang*/ goms pa rdzogs nas de gsal ba// mtha' gzhan bkag pa'i nges pas 'grub// ces pas bstan no// rtags de'i tshul sgrub pa la/ phyogs chos dang khyab sgrub gnyis/ dang po la rten brtan par bsgrub pa/ goms pa ngang gi khyad par du 'gyur ba/ de bsgom pa bsgrub pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ phya pa la sogs pa kha cig rig pa'i ya mtha' dang ma mtha' thug pa med pas snga phyi'i rgyun brtan pa rang rgyud kyi rang rig mngon sum gyis 'grub ste/ dper na mdun gyi du ba tsam me las byung bar mngon sum du grub pas me sngon du ma song ba'i du ba'i rigs mtha' dag khegs pa dang*/ mdun gyi sgron me tsam gyis 'od 'byin par grub pas 'od mi 'byin pa'i sgron me mtha' dag dngos su khegs pa bzhin du rang rgyud kyi rang

(529) rig gis da ltar gyi rig pa tsam rig pas snga ma las byung bar grub pas rig pa snga ma sngon du ma song ba'i rig pa tsam khegs/ rig pa da ltar bas rig pa phyi ma bskyed pa rang rig gis grub pas rig pa phyi ma mi skyed pa'i rig pa tsam khegs pa yin no// zer ba mi 'thad de/ des da ltar gyi rig pa tsam rig pa snga phyi dang*/ 'brel ba can du grub kyang*/ skye ba dang 'chi ba'i rig pas thog mtha' thug med du mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ me dang sgron me'ang 'di'i dpe ru mi rung ba'i phyir/ rang gi lugs la 'das pa thug med dang ma 'ongs pa thug med du sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po la rtags 'god pa na/ skyes ma thag pa'i sems chos can/ nyer len gyi rgyu snga ma sngon du song ste/ rig pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ da ltar gyi rig pa bzhin ces bya ba'i 'bras rtags 'di yin te/ rtsa bar yang*/ sems las gzhan la ltos med kyi// rtags kyis sngon mtha' thug med 'grub// ces pa'i don no// gnyis pa ma 'ongs pa sgrub pa ni/ sems kyi phyi mtha' rten brtan pa'am rgyun brtan par sgrub pa yin zhing*/ 'di la rang 'grel du/ bdag 'dzin dang bcas pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin med pa'i gsal ba thug med du bsgrub pa'i sa bcad gnyis mdzad nas/ slar (530) sa bcad phyi ma rang gi thad du gsal ba tsam rten brten par bsgrub zhes snga ma dang mi 'dra ba zhig bshad snang la/ kun mkhyen g.yag pa dang*/ glo bo mkhan chen gnyis kyis/ 'grel pa'i dpe la ji ltar yod pa de ka sor bzhag mdzad/ paṇa chen dang kun mkhyen chen po sogs kyis bcad phyi ma'i thad rang du/ tshig rang 'grel gyi de las 'don pa ma bsgyur yang*/ don bdag 'dzin med pa'i gsal ba thug med la sbyar nas bshad/ rje btsun mus rab 'byams pas/ gsal ba tsam rten brtan par bsgrub par 'don pa bsgyur te sngar gyi sa bcad gnyis pa de dngos su bzhes par mdzad/ rang gi bsam tshod sngar gyi sa bcad gnyis pa bsdebs pa gnang ba'i skabs su/

gsal ba tsam rten brtan par bsgrub pa gnyis par 'os shis/ bdag 'dzin med pa'i gsal ba thug med ni tshig grogs snga ma'i 'gros las gzhan zhig gi blos btags shor ba las 'os med do// de ltar gnyis kyi dang po la gsum las/ dang po rtags 'god pa ni/ bdag 'dzin can gyi skyes bu 'chi kha ma'i sems chos can/ bdag 'dzin can gyi tshe phyi ma'i sems bskyed nges te/ de'i rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i phyir/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pa tha ma'i myu gu bzhin// zhes (531) pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtags kyis bdag 'dzin can gyi sems kyi phyi mtha' bdag 'dzin ma spangs kyi bar du 'grub pa yin te/ rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i// rtags kyis phyi mtha' thug med 'grub// ces pa'i don no// gnyis pa tshul sgrub pa la/ phyogs chos dang khyab bsgrub gnyis las/ dang po la/ 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog shes dgos pas de la dgag bzhag spangs gsum las/ dang po ni/ las dang lus sems 'khor ba'i rgyu// gnyis pa spangs phyir dka' spyod zer// zhes sogs tshig bcad kyis bstan/ 'di'i phyogs snga ma paṇa chen gyis mu stegs spyod pa pa dang*/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis gcer bu ba la ngos bzung ba las phyi ma 'thad par sems te/ lus kyi dka' thub me lnga brten pa sogs thar lam du 'dod pa gcer bu ba'i lugs su snang ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rang lugs la/ spyir yang srid tsam skye ba'i rgyu ni ma rig pa yin te/ ma rig pa las nyon mongs dang las dang skye ba gsum rim bzhin du 'byung ba'i phyir/ bye brag dbang shes skye ba'i rgyu ni/ skye mched 'di las skye mched gzhan// de yi bzang ngan las kyi byed// ces pa'i don/ 'chi kha'i dbang shes kyis nyer len byas/ 'chi kha'i dbang po (532) gzugs can pas lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas phyi ma'i dbang shes skye la/ 'chi kha'i nang gi skye mched kyis nyer len byas/

'chi kha'i dbang shes kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa las/ phyi ma'i nang gi skye mched gzhan skye zhing*/ skye mched gnyis po de'i bzang ngan gyi khyad par las kyis byed pa yin no// paṇa chen gyis/ yang srid skye ba'i rgyu la ma rig pa 'phen byed dang*/ las 'grub byed kyi rgyur mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/ ma rig pa ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba can yin yang 'phen byed ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ tshe snga ma'i dbang shes rgyu 'bras las phyi ma'i dbang shes rgyu 'bras skye ba la 'grub byed kyi las mi dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dir gzugs med khams na dbang po gzugs can pa dang dbang shes dang*/ gzugs sgra yod med kyi mtha' chod rgya 'grel dang sbyar ba ni/ blo gros gsar bu ba dag skrag pa skye bar 'gyur bas re zhig ma spros so// 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu de'i gnyen po ni// bdag med bdag dang 'gal bas na// bdag med mthong bas de sun 'byin// zhes pa ltar/ bdag med mngon sum rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bdag 'dzin gnyis lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi gnod bya gnod byed yin pas/ tsha grang bzhin shes rab skyes pa na bdag 'dzin myur du yul thon nas 'bras

(533) bu 'khor ba'i skye ba las grol te/ rnam 'grel las/ stong nyid lta dang de 'gal phyir// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang 'grel las/ rtag mi rtag gam zhes pa'i 'dam kha can gyi dpe gsungs pa ni/ yul bdag dang bdag med kyi 'gal ba'i dpe yin la/ de la de gnyis phan tshun spang 'gal las 'os med pas bdag spyi tsam pa dngos po khas len e nus dpyad par bya'o// gsum pa rtsod spangs la/ skye rgyu la rtsod pa spang ba dang*/ gnyen po la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ rgyu gsum gsungs pa dang*/ 'gal ba spang ba sogs gsum yod pa 'grel par gsal/ gnyis pa gnyen po la rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis las/ dang po la rtsa tshig dngos su med kyang 'grel par gsung tshul brjod na/ ma rig pa dang bral bas skye ba mi len na/ mthong lam skyes pa nyid nas skye ba mi len par 'gyur ro zhes rtsod na/ ma rig pa dang bral ba'i gtan tshigs ma grub te/ mthong lam pas ma rig pa kun btags spangs kyang 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i lhan skyes ma spangs pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ lhan cig skyes pa ma spang phyir// spang na yang srid ga la yod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na dgra bcom pas lhan skyes (534) kyi bdag ma spangs yang srid mi len pa dang*/ sa brgyad pa pas lhan skyes kyi bdag spangs kyang yang srid len pa 'gal lo zhe na/ 'di'i lan la rang 'grel du grub mtha' smra ba dag gi lan 'debs bzhir bshad pa la/ so so'i ngos 'dzin ni/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis/ dang po mngon pa kun btus kyi rjes 'brang dag dang*/ gnyis pa spyod 'jug las/ srid 'di nyon mongs can min yang*// kun rmongs bzhin du ci ste med// ces pa'i don/ dgra bcom pa la nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i sred pa yod la/ de rang ngam gzhan gyis sad nas theg chen lam du 'jug pa'i grub mtha' dang sbyar/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa yang nyan thos sde pa 'ga' zhig la ngos 'dzin gsung ba'i gsal kha re mdzad/

gzhan dgongs 'grel phal cher na gsal kha cher mi snang*/ 'di 'dra'i rigs can kun la blo gros rtsal du bton nas bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa gang long dang gsal kha dgos pa phyogs snga ngos 'dzin dang lung khung 'tshol dgos pa sogs la yid ches kyi gsal kha thon pa rang cag rjes 'brang kun gyi bya bar rigs te/ de ltar byas na bstan pa la bya ba byas par 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu chos kyi rjes ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug pa sogs (535) don chen po dang ldan no// kwa ye grogs dag don med bya ba kun// gzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin dor la thos bsam sbyongs// dpyod ldan rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin nus pa// gcig tsam yin yang 'jig rten snang bar nus// nyi ma zla ba re re tsam yin yang*// gling bzhin kun tu gsal bar byed la ltos// thos dang bsam pa'i bag chags gong 'phel bas// skye ba kun tu'ang mkhas pa'i rgyal sa thob// bar gyi tshigs bcad do// gnyen po la rtsod spang gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten lhan skyes kyi bdag spangs pas yang srid mi len na/ bdag 'dzin can gyi sems brtan pa mi 'grub bo zhe na/ lan ni/ sa bon thog ma yod min yang*// mes bsregs pa na phyi mtha' mthong*// de bzhin 'khor ba thog med kyang*// bdag med mthong na phyi mtha' 'grub// ces pa ltar na/ sa bon gyi dpe bzhin du/ 'khor ba spyi dang gang zag sgos gcig gi'ang 'khor ba la thog ma med kyang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi me skyes te bdag 'dzin gyi sa bon nye bar bsregs pa na 'khor ba'i phyi mtha' 'grub la/ des na stong nyid mngon sum ma rtogs kyi bar du rten brtan pas chog mod/ stong nyid rtogs kyang srid pa phyi ma len pa'i rten brtan na/ gang zag so so bas (536) lam ji tsam bsgom kyang don med par 'gyur te/ so so ba'i 'khor ba rgyun mi 'chad pas so// gnyis pa gsal ba tsam rten brtan par sgrub pa ni/

gsal ba bskyed la rgyu tshang zhing*// gegs med phyir na bskyed par nges// zhes pa ltar/ gang sems gsal ba tsam bskyed pa la rgyu tshang zhing gegs med na/ rig pa phyi ma bskyed par nges pas khyab/ dper na gegs med cing tshogs pa tshang ba'i sa bon bzhin sems phyi ma bskyed pa la gegs med cing tshogs pa tshang ba'i 'chi kha'i sems kyang sems gsal ba tsam bskyed pa la rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa yin no// zhes pa'i rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs kyis 'grub bo// paṇa chen gyis/ dgra bcom pa 'chi kha'i rig pa chos can/ rang 'bras phyi ma bskyed par nges te/ gsal ba tsam bskyed pa la rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa ni/ sgrub byed bsgrub bya dang mtshungs pa'i ma grub pa yin te/ dgra bcom tha ma'i rig pa des gsal ba tsam bskyed pa la rgyu tshogs tshang ba dang*/ rang 'bras gsal rig phyi ma bskyed par byed pa rnams/ ri bong gi rwa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// yang paṇa chen gyis/ ma rig pa ma spangs pa de srid du 'khor ba 'byung rung du bsgrub pa de ni/ gzhung 'dir rnal 'byor (537) mngon sum sgrub byed kyi rigs pa yin pa lta bur gsungs kyang*/ snying rje skye ba du mar gom pa mi srid pa'i rtsod lan du sbyar na legs te/ rnam nges las de ltar gsungs pas so// zhes bris pa yang zhib tu mi dpyod par bdag nyid chen po la gzhi med du rgol bar snang yang*/ gzhung 'dir rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i// rtags kyis phyi mtha' thug med 'grub// ces pa ni/ rnal 'byor mngon sum sgrub byed kyi rang bzhin gyi rtags kyi zur rten brtan par sgrub pa la/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa sgrub pa gnyis bshad pa'i phyi ma de yin zhing*/ de las 'phros nas spyir 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu dang*/ bye brag tshe 'di'i skye mched las phyi ma'i skye mched skye tshul dang bcas pa sogs gsungs pa mngon sum du gsal bas de la skyon gtong ci yod/

rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi phyogs chos sgrub byed kyi rigs pa yin pas don gyis rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi sgrub byed du 'gyur ba gzhir bzhag la/ don gyis rnal 'byor mngon sum sgrub pas snying rje skye ba du mar gom pa mi srid pa'i rtsod lan du sbyor rgyu mi yong na ha cang thal te/ ma rig pa ma spangs pa de srid du 'khor ba 'byung rung bsgrubs pas skye ba snga phyi grub ste rnal 'byor (538) mngon sum gyi rgyu stong nyid snying rje skye ba du mar gom pa 'grub pa khyed la mi 'thad par thal ba'i phyir ro// 'dir gsal bskyed la rgyu tshang zhing sogs rkang pa gnyis dang sngar gyi rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i sogs rkang pa gnyis/ snga phyi'i brjod don gcig tu snang bas zlos so zhe na/ rgya che chung ngam don gzhan gyi sgo nas khyad par cung zad dgos par snang bas/ dpyod ldan dag gis thos bsam rgya bskyed la dpyad par bya'o// rtsa ba'i gnyis pa goms pa ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur ba dang*/ gsum pa de bsgom pa ni rang rgyud kyi rang rig gis 'grub bo// gnyis pa rtsa ba'i khyab pa bsgrub pa ni/ 'jigs sogs goms las gsal snang dang*// zhes pa ltar/ dpe'i steng du khyab pa 'grub pa yin te/ dpe 'dod 'jigs sogs goms pa'i steng du goms pa las gsal snang skye bar mngon sum du mthong bas grub pa'i phyir ro// 'di la yang*/ paṇa chen gyis/ dpe'i steng du khyab pa cha mthun tsam sgrub pa yin zhes dang*/ gong gi gtan tshigs gnyis pa goms pa rang gi ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur pa ni rang rig gis 'grub bo// zhes 'grel par gsungs pa yang cha mthun tsam yin la/ sgrub byed kyi rtags mtshan nyid pa ni/ rnam 'grel (539) du/ sems la brtse sogs goms skye ba// rang gi ngang gis 'jug 'gyur te// me la sogs pa shing dag dang*// dngul chu dang ni gser sogs bzhin// zhes pas bstan gsungs pa yang*/

'jam dbyangs la cung zad rgol 'dod du snang yang*/ rnam 'grel gyi de la mkhyen pa'i spyan ras ma zhugs pa ga la yin/ khyed rang gzhung des sgrub byed kyi rtags mtshan nyid pa bstan gsungs pa 'ol spyod de/ gzhung des dpe tsam lhag po ma gtogs gzhan sgrub byed kyi rtags su bzung bya ci yang dngos su ma bstan pa'i phyir te/ tshig rkang snga ma gnyis kyi ni rtse sogs goms pa ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur ba'i sgrub chos tsam zhig gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir te zhes pa 'og gi dpe dang 'brel ba tsam yin pas/ de las gzhan pa'i rtags zur pa bstan ma bstan la thugs gzu bor gnas pa zhu zhes thal mo snying kar sbyor ba lags so// gnyis pa mtshan nyid sgrub pa ni/ gzung 'dzin med phyir 'khrul med 'grub// ces pa ltar/ rnal 'byor mngon sum chos can/ ma 'khrul ba yin te/ lam bsgom pa las gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ rtog pa dang yang bral ba (540) yin te/ 'khrul pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ des na kun rdzob ji ltar gnas pa ltar gzigs pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi ye shes ni snang bcas rnal 'byor mngon sum dang*/ don dam ji ltar yin pa ltar gzigs pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi ye shes ni snang med rnal 'byor mngon sum du grub cing*/ snang bcas snang med kyang sngar bshad pa ltar/ kun rdzob snang cha yul gyi gtso bor byed pa dang*/ don dam gnas lugs yul gyi gtso bor byed pa'i khyad par yin gyi/ gnyis snang dang bcas ma bcas ni ga la yin te/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin na/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang spangs pa gcig dgos pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ rnam 'grel las/ rtog pa'i dra ba spangs pa'i phyir/ gsal ba nyid du snang ba yin// zhes dang*/ rang 'grel las/ des na kun rdzob ji ltar gnas pa dang don dam ji ltar gnas pa ltar gzigs pas snang bcas dang*/ snang med kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum gnyis ka rtog bral ma 'khrul par grub te/

zhes gsungs pa yin no// gsum pa grub pa'i don la mi 'thad pa spang ba la gnyis te/ spangs pa phun tshogs mi 'thad pa spang ba dang*/ ye shes phun tshogs mi 'thad pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ mi nus mi shes mi brtan phyir// spangs pa'i grol ba med ce na// zhes pa'i (541) don/ phyi rol pa kha cig dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas spong mi nus pa dang*/ nus kyang spong ba'i thabs mi shes shing shes nas lan gcig spangs kyang lus kyi dri ma ltar slar ldog pa'i phyir/ spangs pa phun tshogs mi srid do zhe na/ de'i lan ni/ rang bzhin min phyir thabs yod phyir// rgyu spong phyir na rnam grol 'thad// ces gsungs te/ rim bzhin/ dri ma ni glo bur ba yin pas sems kyi rang bzhin ma yin la/ spong ba'i thabs kyang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu bdag 'dzin yin pas de'i gnyen por bdag med pa'i don bsgom pa'i thabs yod pa dang*/ rgyu bdag 'dzin spangs pa nyid kyis dri ma slar mi ldog pa'i phyir na spangs pa phun tshogs 'thad pa yin no// 'di'i phyogs snga ma paṇa chen gyis spyod pa pa la sbyar/ 'grel pa sogs na phyi rol pa kha cig zhes pa las gsal kha mi snang*/ rang gi go tshod rnam 'grel las/ rtag nyid phyir ram thabs med phyir// yang na thabs ni mi shes phyir// skyon rnams mi zad pa nyid ces// bya bar yongs su rtog grang na// zhes pa 'di/ rgyal dpog pa'i 'dod pa brjod pa yin pas/ rigs gter gyi 'di yang rgyal dpog pa la sbyor dgos sam snyam ste/ spongs pa phun tshogs mi 'thad pa'i rtsod (542) pa rtsod lan de dag rnam rigs gnyis don gcig na 'dus pas rtsod pa'i phyogs snga yang gcig pa las 'os med pa'i phyir/ rgyal dpog pa dang*/ spyod pa ba ming gi rnam grangs su bshad do snyam na/ de bshad kyang grub mtha'i khyad par so sor yod pas/ phyogs snga ngos 'dzin so sor byed dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ mchongs dang chu dang gser gyi dpes// goms pa srid pa min zhe na// zhes pa'i don/

phyi rol pa kha cig mchongs goms kyang mtha' med du mi mchongs pa ltar/ rtse ba dang shes rab sogs goms kyang thug med du 'phel mi srid/ yang chu ji ltar bsros kyang mer mi 'bar ba ltar/ rtse sogs goms kyang cung zad rtogs pa las de'i ngang du 'gro mi srid/ yang gser bzhu yang me dang bral ba na sra bar 'gyur ba ltar rtse sogs lan cig rtogs kyang 'bad pa dang bral ba na slar ldog la/ des na ye shes phun sum tshogs pa 'byung mi nus so zhes rtsod par byed/ 'di ni rnam 'grel le'u gnyis par/ goms las khyad par 'gyur na yang*// mchongs dang chu yi drod bzhin du// rang bzhin las 'das min zhe na// zhes bshad pa de yin zhing*/ phyi rol pa su'i zhe na/ sgrub byed thugs rje goms las de// zhes pa las 'phros/ rgyang 'phen pa'i rtsod (543) pa yin no// lan ni/ 'bad la ltos phyir mi brtan phyir// slar 'byung bskyed phyir dper mi rung*// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel du/ byas te gal te slar yang ni// 'bad stsol la ni ltos 'gyur ram// rten mi brten pa nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ don ni/ mchongs pa ni lus kyi stobs yin pas goms kyang tshad can dang*/ rtse ba dang shes rab sogs ni sems kyi chos yin pas goms na tshad med par 'phel bar nus la/ des na dpe don de mi 'byor zhing khyad par shin tu che ba yod/ yang chu bsros kyang me 'bar ba'i sngon du chu'i dros kyi rten mi brtan pas skam par 'gyur ba dang*/ me 'bar ba'i rang bzhin yang ma yin la/ sems ni goms na brtse sogs kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur bas dpe 'di yang mi rung la/ yang gser bzhu ba ni rang rgyu las slar sra bar 'byung ba bskyed la/ rtse sogs goms pas ni slar ldog mi rung du rang rgyus bskyed pa'i phyir na dpe de 'dir mi rung zhing dpe don la khyad par shin tu che ba yod do// gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa mi srid pa thal ba spang ba la gnyis las/

dang po rtsod pa ni/ stong nyid snying rje goms pa las// de yi ngang du 'gyur srid mod// shes bya (544) kun la mtha' med phyir// kun mkhyen sgrub pa dka' zhes zer// zhes te rtsod pa po ni/ 'grel par mu stegs 'ga' zhig ces bshad pa// paṇa chen gyis spyod pa ba la ngos bzung*// glo bo mkhan chen gyis chad lta ba la ngos bzung ba gnyis las/ phyi ma 'thad de/ chad lta ba rang gi gzhung las/ shes bya mtha' yas kun shes min// shes byed gzhan yod thug pa med// gcig gi rgyu dang mi rgyu ba// thams cad shes par bya mi nus// sbyor ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir// bstan bcos kun shes ga la srid// rig byed dag ni thams cad kyis// 'don pa gang dag mi srid cing*// 'jig rten dag na mi rnams dang*// mu stegs byed la kun mkhyen med// ces bshad pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la ni/ rnam grol don gnyer gyi gdul bya la nye bar mkho ba'i gtso bo 'khor bar 'jug ldog gi rgyu 'bras bden bzhi phyin ci ma log par ston shes na/ dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa grub te/ mi kun tshogs sman kun tshang zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ 'o na rdul phran dang srin bu'i grangs sogs mi mkhyen na thams cad mkhyen par mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ srin bu'i grangs sogs ni thar pa don gnyer gyi gdul bya la nyer mkho med pas mkhyen kyang rung*/

(545) mi mkhyen yang rung ba'i gtso bo bden bzhi phyin ci ma log par mkhyen na thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur te/ dper na thams cad 'dus nas chos nyan gin 'dug ces pa la/ ba glang ma 'dus kyang thams cad ma 'dus pa'i skyon du mi 'gro ba bzhin no// 'di ni rtsa bar/ dgos pa'i don kun shes pa la// mkhas rnams thams cad mkhyen ces zer// thams cad 'dus nas nyan pa la// ba glang med kyang skyon ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// yang dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa des srin bu'i grangs sogs shes bya'i don kun mkhyen pa nyid kyang rjes dpag gis grub te/ rten gzhi'i gtan tshigs bkod na ston pa thub pa'i dbang po chos can/ khyod kyis rdul phran gyi grangs sogs shes bya'i don rtogs sla ba thams cad kyang mkhyen pa yin te/ phra zhing dka' ba bden pa bzhi'i don phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pa'i phyir/ dper na phra ba nyi zer gyi rdul mthong ba des yid gtad na bum pa la sogs pa mthong sla ba bzhin zhes pa 'di yin no// 'dir dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa thog mar sgrub/ de nas shes bya'i don kun mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen par sgrub par mdzad pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'dod pa'i rgol (546) ba'i ngor rim can du sgrub dgos pa byung ba yin gyis/ mtshan gzhi so sor dgos pa ni ma yin te/ don gnas tshul de gnyis la khyad par med cing don gcig yin pa'i phyir ro// kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad kyi gnad dam pa ni rang gzhan kun gyi snying la bcang bar bya'o// rgol ba'i ngor rim can du dgos tshul ni/ dang por shes bya'i don kun mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub na sgrub dka' zhing khos kyang rtogs dka' ba yin pas/ dang por kha khrid la thar pa don gnyer la mkho ba'i dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa de tsam sgrub nas/

de grub na de'i rtags las rdul phran gyi don sogs shes bya'i don gzhan dag kyang mkhyen sla bar sgrub pas mthar shes bya'i don ma lus par mkhyen pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa grub te/ thams cad mkhyen pa med par 'dod pa'i log rtog bzlog nas yod pa'i nges shes skye ba yin no// 'di dag ni/ rtsa bar/ yang na rjes su dpag pa yis// thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa yin// bskal pa'i bar du brjod rgyu yang*// me long nang du cig car 'char// de bzhin shes bya mtha' med pa// mkhyen pa'i skad cig cig gis mkhyen// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// //yang dag don la sgom byung gsal snang gi / (547) 'phags pa'i blo de rnal 'byor mngon sum yin// dbye na theg gsum 'phags pa'i mngon sum gsum// slob dang mi slob sgo nas phye na lnga// de dag rang yul snang bcas snang med kyis// dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bcu ru'ang 'gyur// thabs shes nyer len rgyu dang byed rkyen du// legs sbyangs ye shes gzigs pa rnam gnyis 'grub// theg gsum rang rang 'bras bu thob pa ni// theg gsum rnal 'byor mngon sum mthar phyin tshad// nyan rang thabs ma gom pas ston pa min// thabs yun gom pas sangs rgyas ston par grub// snga rabs mkhas 'ga' rnal 'byor mngon sum dag /bcad shes gzhi mthun 'dod kyang rigs pas gnod// so skye kun dang 'phags pa'i rjes thob tu// tshad mas nges drangs yul la 'jug ldog byed// rtog bral 'phags rnams ting 'dzin stobs las yin// sangs rgyas ye shes blo 'das su yis brjod// tshig gi khyad par nges las sngon byung dang*// rten brten goms pa rdzogs las gsal snang blo// 'byung bar sgrub pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyis// sgrub byed rnam gnyis 'bras dang rang bzhin yin// rtags zur rten brtan sgrub la phya pa sogs// me dang sgron me dper mdzad 'dir mi 'thad// rig pa yin phyir nyer len sems snga ma// sngon song

(548) sgrub kyi sngon mtha' thug med 'grub// phyi ma bskyed la rgyu tshogs gegs med phyir// phyi ma bskyed ces phyi mtha' 'ang thug med 'grub// gcer bu ba dag lus sems 'khor ba'i rgyu// yin phyir lus la dka' thub rten zhes zer// 'dir ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig yin// gnyen po bdag med mthong bas de sun 'byin// de tshe 'khor ba'i sngon mtha' ma dmigs kyang*// phyi mtha' mngon te thar pa'i rgyal sa zin/ gsal ba bskyed la rgyu tshogs gegs med phyir// phyi ma bskyed pa'ang phyogs chos sgrub byed yin// 'jigs sogs gsal snang dpe yis khyab pa sgrub// de dag rang bzhin rtags kyi phyogs sgrub yin// don 'di ma go 'jam dbyangs bla ma la// rgol 'dod dregs pa'i nga ro cher 'byin kyang*// zhib tu ma brtags ches rlom rnam thar bzhin// rang gi de nyid gsal bar ston pa tsam// de bas rang rang blo dang bsod nams kyis// 'bad pas 'jam dbyangs dgongs pa ci long zhu// gzung 'dzin med dang 'khrul pa bral ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul 'grub// spong bar mi nus spong ba'i thabs mi shes// mi brtan phyir na spangs pa med ces brtsod// rang bzhin min dang thabs yod rgyu spong phyir// spangs pa kun tshogs rgol ba su yis 'gog /chad lta ba dag (549) mchongs dang chu sogs dpes// rtse sogs goms pa med dang shes bya la// mtha' med thams cad mkhyen pa med ces zer// dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen na kun mkhyen te// dper na thams cad 'dus nas chos nyan bzhin// yang na dgos pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i phyir// rdul phran grangs sogs mi mkhyen lta ci smos// des na shes bya'i don kun mkhyen par grub// bskal par brjod rgyu'i shes bya mtha' med kyang*// mkhyen pas skad cig gcig la mngon sum mkhyen// sdom tshig 'di dag kyang gong gi brjod don thad sor sbyor shes na/

go rim mi 'khrug cing don rnams blo la 'jam shing 'jags par 'gyur ba yin no// rnal 'byor mngon sum bstan zin to// //gnyis pa mngon sum ltar snang la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'khrul pa'i shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de la dbye na rtog pa dang*/ rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshad ma mdo las/ 'khrul dang kun rdzob shes pa dang*// rjes dpag rjes su dpag las byung*// dran dang mngon 'dod ces bya'o// zhes rtog pa drug gsungs pa chos kyi grags pas gsum du bsdus pa yin te/ dang po 'khrul dang zhes pas don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa (550) bstan/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rmig sgyu la chur 'khrul pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o// kun rdzob shes pa dang*/ zhes pas brda rten can gyi rtog pa bstan/ mtshan gzhi ni/ ba glang gi spyi 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu'o// de gnyis rigs pa can pas dbang shes su 'dod pa'i log rtog yod pas de dgag par bya ba'i phyir dbye ba so sor grangs 'dzin/ rjes dpag gi ming can rtags 'dzin sems dang*/ de las byung ba rtags can rjes dpag dang*/ mngon sum dang rtags gang la yang mi ltos pa 'das pa'i don dran pa'i dran shes dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i don mngon par 'dod pa'i blo dang bzhi ni/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don can gyi rtog pa yin pas gsum du 'du zhing*/ gsum gyi steng du rtog med mngon sum ltar snang bsnan pas bzhir 'gyur ba la dgongs nas/ rnam 'grel las/ mngon sum ltar snang rnam pa bzhi// rtog pa'i shes pa rnam gsum dang*// rten bslad pa las byung ba can// rtog pa med pa gcig yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyogs glang gis lkog tu gyur pa'i don can gyi rtog pa la bzhir phye nas so sor mdzad pa ni/ rtog pa snga ma gnyis dbang shes ma yin par sgrub pa'i mthun dpe la mang du yod pa sgrub pa'i phyir du yin pas drug tu phye ba ni dgos pa'i sgo nas yin te/

rnam 'grel (551) las/ dbang skyes min par grub don du// gnyis bshad 'khrul pa mthong phyir ro// rjes dpag sogs grub brjod pa ni// snga ma gnyis nyid bsgrub phyir ro// zhes dang*/ 'dir yang*/ rtog pa gsum yin drug bshad pa// log rtog ldog phyir phye ste gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtog med mngon sum ltar snang la/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rtog med kyi 'khrul pa'i shes pa dbye na dbang shes 'khrul pa dang*/ yid shes 'khrul pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skra bshad 'dzag snang gi dbang shes lta bu yin te/ tshad ma mdo las/ mngon sum ltar snang rab rib bcas// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gnyid log pa'i gnas skabs dang gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi yid shes 'khrul pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su rta glang sogs gsal bar snang ba'i shes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbang shes skad cig dang pos bdag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i zla ba gnyis snang gi yid shes lta bu'o// de skad du/ rnam 'grel las/ gnyid log pa dang sad pa dang*// gsal bar snang ba can blo gang*// de ni rtog med ces gsungs so// 'o na rtog pa chos can/ rtog med mngon sum ltar snang yin par thal/ yid shes 'khrul pa yin (552) pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ yid shes gang zhig 'khrul pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer na/ rtog med kyi yid shes 'khrul pa de rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gi dbye ba yin zer ba'i zhib cha shes dgos so// 'khrul pa'i shes kun mngon sum ltar snang yin/ de la gnyis dbye dang po rtog pa la// mdo las drug bshad rnam 'grel gsum du bsdu// rtog med dbang yid sgo nas gnyis 'di 'thad// mngon sum ltar snang bstan zin to// //gsum pa tshad ma'i 'bras bu la gnyis te/ tshad 'bras gang la 'phros pa'i tshul dang*/ de las 'phros pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag go

/dang po ni/ tshad ma mdor/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /tshad ma'o mtshan nyid gnyis gzhal bya// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel du/ gzhal bya gnyis phyir tshad ma gnyis// zhes pa'i skabs su/ tshad ma la gnyis su grangs nges pa'i sgrub byed du/ gzhal bya la gnyis su grangs nges pa bkod pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na tshad ma gnyis po des gzhal bya gnyis po de rtogs pa'i sgrub byed gang zhe na/ de'i sgrub byed tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ston par byed pa la/ bya ba sgrub par byed ces te// zhes pa nas/ rang rig ces ni rab tu bshad// (553) ces pa'i bar tshad 'bras bzhi po'i gzhung tshogs 'di dag byung*/ de la yang nang sel phye na/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi don rig mngon sum gyis don rang mtshan rtogs te/ de'i rnam ldan du skyes pa'i phyir zhes ston pa la/ bya ba sgrub par zhes pa nas// sgro 'dogs pas ni 'jug phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar gyis tshad 'bras dang po'i gzhung dang*/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi rang rig mngon sum gyis shes pa rang mtshan rtogs te/ shes pa de myong ba'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir zhes ston pa la/ don rig gang yin so sor rig /ces pa nas/ don rig par ni 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ yang tshad 'bras dang po'i skabs su don gyi rnam ldan du skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis don rtogs par bzhag pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na dpyad pa'i tshe yang don rtogs pa yin nam zhe na/ rang la dngos su snang ba de nyid shes pa rang gi bdag nyid yin pas dpyad na rang gi 'bras bu yin no// zhes ston pa dang*/ tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras kyi skabs su yang tha snyad du don rtogs par bzhag pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na dpyad pa'i tshe'ang don rtogs sam zhe na/ de'i tshe don ma rtogs te/ de'i tshe rang gi bdag nyid rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ ston pa la/ phyi rol don ni yod na yang*// zhes (554) pa nas/ de 'dra ngas kyang mi shes so// zhes pa'i bar gyi tshad 'bras gsum pa'i gzhung tshogs 'di dag dang*/

tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i don dam rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi skabs su bzung 'dzin rig gsum la tshad 'bras gzhal gsum du 'jog pa yin no// zhes ston pa la/ blo bdag rnam par dbyer med kyang*// zhes pa nas/ rang rig ces ni rab tu bshad// ces pa'i bar gyi tshad 'bras bzhi pa'i gzhung tshogs 'di dag byung*/ gnyis pa de las 'phros pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag la gsum ste/ tshad 'bras spyi'i rnam gzhag tshad 'bras so so'i rnam gzhag zhar byung rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ tshad 'bras rdzas gzhan du 'dod pa'i lugs dgag rdzas gzhan ma yin par 'dod pa'i rang lugs bzhag rdzas gzhan min pa la rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ rnam 'grel las/ de phyir mthong dang dbang 'brel dang*// khyad par gyi ni blo de dag /ces dang*/ de'i don rigs gter las/ lta dang nges pa tshad 'bras dang*// phrad dang don rtogs tshad 'bras 'dod// khyad par khyad par can der smra// la la dbang shes tshad 'bras 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ spyod pa bas/ don dngos gzhal bya/ dang por don la lta ba'i (555) rtog med kyi shes pa tshad ma/ de'i rjes su 'byung ba'i dngos chos dang*/ rigs sogs kyi khyad par la zhen pa'i blo 'bras bu zhes dang*/ rig pa can pas/ don gzhal bya/ dbang po dang don 'phrad pa tshad ma/ de'i rjes su byung ba'i don rtogs pa'i blo 'bras bu zhes dang*/ bye brag pas/ don gzhal bya/ yon tan la sogs pa'i khyad par 'dzin pa'i blo tshad ma/ khyad par can rdzas 'dzin pa'i blo 'bras bu zhes dang*/ bye brag smra bas/ don gzhal bya/ rten bcas kyi dbang po gzugs can pa tshad ma/ de las byung ba'i shes pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'dod la/ de dag ni mi 'thad de/ tshad mar 'dod pa de dag gis 'bras bur 'dod pa de dag sgrub par mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de lta bu'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag so so'i tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan gyi tshad ma dang 'bras bu gnyis po de rdzas gzhan dang snga phyi ba yin pa'i phyir/

de skad du/ rnam 'grel las/ bya ba la ni chod pa'i phyir// tshad ma nyid du mi 'dod do// zhes gsungs so// des na de lta bu'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag bzhi po de tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag tsam yin te/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ltar snang yin pa'i phyir te/ chod pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin pa'i phyir te/ (556) tshad ma dang 'bras bu dus mi mnyam pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin pa'i phyir te/ de dag gi tshad ma dang 'bras bu la rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pa grub pa'i phyir/ de dag tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan ma yin te/ ma chod pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ma yin pa'i phyir te/ tshad 'bras bdag nyid gcig pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi tshad ma dang 'bras bu la mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel pa grub pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ dngos chos dang rigs sogs kyi khyad par la zhen pa'i blo yin par thal/ dang por don la lta ba'i rtog med kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan mtshon bshag ma grub na/ der thal/ dang por don mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtog med kyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ zhen blo yin par thal lo// gnyis pa la/ dbang po gzugs can pa dang phyi don 'phrad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dbang po gzugs can pa chos can/ dbang don 'phrad pa'i rjes su byung ba'i don rtogs pa'i shes pa yin par thal/ dbang don 'phrad pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ der thal/ dbang don gzugs can pa dang phyi don phrad pa yin pa'i phyir/

(557) chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ khyad par gyi chos yon tan tsam 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ 'bras bu der thal/ tshad ma de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod chos yon tan 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ khyad chos yon tan tsam 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ rten bcas kyi mig dbang gzugs can pa chos can/ 'bras bu der thal/ tshad ma de'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan du gyur pa'i tshad ma dang 'bras bu gnyis don gzhan mi 'thad pa des na 'thad ldan du gyur pa la rnam par 'jog byed kyi rgyu la tshad ma dang*/ rnam par bzhag bya'i 'bras bu la 'bras bur 'jog pa yin te/ tshad ma ni mtshan nyid dang*/ 'bras bu ni mtshon byar bzhag pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ des na tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan gyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan gyi tshad ma yin na/ sgrub byed dang byed pa dang*/ mtshan nyid dang rnam par 'jog byed yin pas khyab/ yang de 'thad ldan gyi 'bras bu yin na/ bsgrub bya dang bya ba dang mtshon bya dang rnam par gzhag bya yin pas khyab te/ mdo'i rang 'grel las/ 'di la phyi rol pa rnams kyi bzhin du/ tshad ma (558) las 'bras bu don gzhan du gyur pa ni med kyi zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ de rnam gzhag la brten nas ni// cha dag bsgrub bya sgrub byed gzhag /ces dang*/ 'dir/ des na rnam par gzhag 'jog gi /rgyu 'bras nyid la tshad 'bras bzhed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig tshad 'bras rdzas gzhan gyi rnam gzhag mi 'thad zer ba zhib cha ma phyed pa ste/ 'o na tshad 'bras rdzas gzhan gyi rnam gzhag med par thal/ de mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yod par thal/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ltar snang yod pa'i phyir te/ chod pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yod pa'i phyir te/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de la chod pa dang ma chod pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/

lha dbang blo'i rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa'i thad kyi 'grel par/ 'di ltar tshad ma'i 'bras bu ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skyes bu'i don zhes bya ba chod pa dang*/ khyad par can chod pa med pa'o// zhes gsungs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ tshad ma'i 'bras bu'i don ni 'thad ldan gyi dbang du byas pa la tshad ma mtshan nyid du byas te de'i mtshon bya rnam par gzhag bya'i 'bras bu la tshad ma'i 'bras bu zhes 'jog pa yin gyi/ rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin te/ tshad ma de yang 'bras bu de'i (559) bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ rnam 'grel las/ de yang de yis bdag nyid yin// des na 'bras bu don gzhan min// zhes gsungs/ paṇa chen gyis/ 'dir 'bras bu zhes bya ba ni tshad ma'i 'bras bu ste/ tshad ma rgyud la skyes pa'i dgos pa'o// zhes bshad pa ni mi 'thad de/ tshad ma'i dgos pa la skabs 'di'i tshad ma'i 'bras bur 'jog na/ skabs 'di'i tshad ma dang 'bras bu rdzas gzhan du 'gyur te/ tshad ma ni dgos pa can yin pas rgyu dang*/ 'bras bu ni de'i dgos pa yin pas de'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid par 'gyur ba las 'os med pas so// gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ tshad 'bras gnyis bsgrub bya sgrub byed ma yin par thal/ tshad 'bras gnyis don gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ khyab pa ma nges te/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi bsgrub bya sgrub byed yin na don gzhan yin dgos kyang*/ rnam par bzhag 'jog gi bsgrub bya sgrub byed yin na don gzhan yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ sgrub byed rnam par 'jog byed kyi rgyu gang las rnam par bzhag bya'i 'bras bu gang yin pa de sgrub nus pa de ni 'dir sgrub byed du 'dod pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di ni rnam 'grel las/ gang las 'bras/ gang yin de ni de (560) sgrub byed// ces pa'i don no// rtags kyi bsgrub bya sgrub byed la ni don gzhan yin min gnyis su yod de/

bskyed bya skyed byed dang rnam par bzhag 'jog gi de gnyis ka rtags kyi bsgrub bya sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir/ gzhal bya gnyis phyir tshad ma'i grangs nges la// 'phros nas tshad mas gzhal bya rtogs pa yis// sgrub byed 'chad la tshad 'bras rnam gzhag byung*// rtogs bya nyid la phyi don rang mtshan dang*// shes pa rang mtshan gnyis yin dang po de// rtogs pa'i sgrub byed tshad 'bras dang pos bstan// gnyis pa rtogs tshul tshad 'bras gnyis pa dang*// bzhi pas bstan yin rnam bden rnam rdzun lugs// phyi don rtogs pa'ang dpyad na btags pa bar// sgrub te rang rig tshad 'bras gsum pa'i don// 'di de mdo sems gnyis kar sbyar du yod// gzhan sde rigs pa can sogs rnam gsum dang*// rang sde bye smra'i tshad 'bras rnam bzhag ni// rdzas gzhan 'dod phyir lugs 'dir 'thad ldan min// 'dir ni rnam par gzhag 'jog tshad 'bras te// mtshan nyid rtags las mtshon bya sgrub phyir ro// ces sbyar ro// gnyis pa tshad 'bras so so'i rnam gzhag la bzhi ste/ don rig smra ba'i tshad 'bras/ rnam rig smra ba'i (561) tshad 'bras/ don rig gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa dpyad nas dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur bstan pa/ rnam rig gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa dpyad nas gzhal bya sgro btags la rang rig btags pa ba'i tshad 'bras ngos bzung ba'o// dang po la/ mdo las ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul// rnam 'grel las ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ de dag gi don gtan la dbab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshad ma mdor/ bya dang bcas pa rtogs pa'i phyir// 'bras bu nyid yin 'jal byed la// tshad ma nyid du 'dogs pa ste// bya ba med pa'ang ma yin no// zhes dang*/ de'i rang 'grel las/ 'di la phyi rol pa rnams kyi bzhin du zhes pa nas/ de bzhin du 'dir yang yin no// ces pa'i bar gyis don rig gi tshad 'bras gsungs pa yin no// don cung zad bshad na/ bya dang bcas pa zhes pas gzhal bya bstan// rtogs pa'i phyir 'bras bu nyid yin zhes pas 'bras bu bstan/

'jal byed la tshad ma nyid du 'dogs pa ste zhes pas tshad ma bstan/ bya ba med pa ma yin no zhes pas don bsdus te bya ba tshad ma'i 'bras bu med pa ma yin pa ste/ yod pa yin no zhes bstan/ de dag la bya byed las gsum kyang tshang ste/ gzhal bya ni las/ tshad ma ni byed pa po/ 'bras (562) bu ni bya ba yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ de yi bdag nyid 'dzin pa de// don rtogs pa yis bdag nyid kyi// byed pas rang gi las la ni// byed dang bcas pa lta bur snang*// zhes dang*/ sa bcad las kyang*/ de lta yin yang bya byed rung*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa'i don ni/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di la spyod pa ba/ rigs pa can pa/ bye brag pa rnams kyi lugs kyi tshad 'bras bzhin du tshad ma dang 'bras bu don gzhan du gyur pa ni med de/ rang lugs kyi tshad 'bras gnyis bdag nyid gcig yin pa'i phyir zhes pa la/ 'di la phyi rol pa rnams kyi bzhin du tshad ma las 'bras bu don gzhan du gyur pa ni med kyis zhes pa 'di byung*/ tshad ma las don gzhan du med na/ tshad ma'i tha snyad zur du bya mi dgos par 'gyur ro zhe na/ tshad ma dang 'bras bu don gzhan du med mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'bras bu de nyid gzhal bya'i rnam pa can du skyes pa dang*/ bya ba dang bcas pa ste las nyid gzhal byar nye bar blang nas 'jal byed la rang yul gyi rnam par shar ba de la byed pa po tshad ma nyid du 'dogs pa ste/ des na bya ba tshad ma'i 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag 'thad pa yin no// zhes pa la/ 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i shes pa de nyid du yul gyi rnam (563) pa can du skyes pa dang*/ bya ba dang bcas pa de nye bar blang nas/ tshad ma nyid du 'dogs pa ste// bya ba med pa'ang ma yin no// zhes pa 'di byung*/ de dag gi dpe ji ltar na/ 'jig rten na bu pha'i gzugs dang 'dra bar skyes pa la/ pha'i gzugs 'dzin zhes brjod pa bzhin du don rig mngon sum rang yul gyi phyi don dang 'dra bar skyes pa'i rtags las/

rang yul gyi don rtogs par 'grub pa yin no// zhes pa la/ dper na 'bras bu rgyu dang rjes su mthun par skyes pa la/ rgyu'i gzugs 'dzin zhes brjod pas/ bya ba med par yang ma yin pa de bzhin du 'dir yang yin no zhes pa 'di byung*/ gnyis pa rnam 'grel las bstan tshul ni/ tshad ma las 'bras bu don gzhan du gyur pa med pa'i dgongs pa bkral ba'i sgo nas tshad 'bras bdag nyid gcig tu sgrub par byed pa la/ bya ba sgrub par byed ces te// zhes sogs byung*/ 'bras bur gyur pa'i shes pa zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa bkral ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu las don gzhan pa'i tshad ma med kyang*/ yul gyi rnam par shar ba'i shes pa la tshad mar 'jog pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ de la nyams myong tsam du na// 'dra ba'i bdag can shes pa ni// zhes pa nas/ des na 'bras bu don (564) gzhan min// zhes pa'i bar tshigs bcad phyed dang drug byung*/ de skad du/ sa bcad las kyang*/ don rtogs 'jog nus sgrub byed yin// 'jog nus khyad par gnyis ldan dgos// des na tshad 'bras don gzhan min// zhes dang*/ shes pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dgos// don gyi rnam pa shar ba dgos// zhes gsungs so// bya ba dang bcas pa zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa bkral ba'i sgo nas byed pa don gyi rnam shes des don rtogs pa'i bya ba byed pas/ rang yul du gyur pa'i las gzugs sogs la tha snyad du/ byed pa dang bcas pa ltar snang yang don la byed pa po ma yin zhing*/ 'on kyang don gyi rnam pa shar ba'i dbang gis tha snyad du don rtogs par bzhag pa yin no// zhes pa la/ de yi bdag nyid ces pa nas// de yi dbang gis der bzhag phyir// zhes pa'i bar byung*/ dper na zhes pa man chad kyi dgongs pa bkral ba'i sgo nas 'jig rten na pha'i gzugs dang 'dra bar skyes pa la/ pha'i gzugs 'dzin zhes brjod pa dper byas te/ rang gi bzung don sngon po dang 'dra bar skyes pa de nyid kyis tha snyad du bzung don sngon po rtogs pa sgrub par byed pa la/

dper na 'bras bu zhes sogs tshigs bcad byung*/ phyi rol pa rnams kyi bzhin du zhes pa (565) la 'phros nas/ phyi rol pas tshad 'bras tshad 'bras rdzas gzhan du 'dod pa'i tshul/ de 'gog byed kyi rigs pa/ de'i lan dgag pa rnams rim bzhin ston pa la/ de phyir mthong dang zhes pa nas// sgro 'dogs pas ni 'jug phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar byung*/ 'dir dbang 'brel zhes pa dbang po don dang phrad pa tsam la zer bas/ rig pa can pa'i lugs kho na yin la/ de ltar na dbang zhes pas bye smra'i 'dod pa ston mi ston brtag par bya dgos te/ phyi rol pa rnams kyi bzhin du zhes pa dang 'di sbyor dgos pa las bye brag tu smra ba phyi rol pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ lha'i 'grel par yang don tsam mthong dang dbang po 'phrad pa dang khyad par gyi blo la de skad ces bya'o// mthong ba dang*/ dbang po dang*/ 'brel pa dang*/ khyad par byed pa can gyi blo dag ni tshad ma nyid du mi 'dod do// zhes gsungs pas kyang 'dir bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa dngos su mi gsal ba'i phyir/ 'dir/ la la dbang shes tshad 'bras 'dod// ces pa ni/ mdzod las/ mig gis gzugs rnams mthong rten bcas// zhes sogs kyi don/ phyogs sngar bzhes nas 'gog par bzhed pa yin te/ rang 'grel nyid las/ tshigs bcad de drangs rjes zhes (566) zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ dbang po tsam don so sor rtogs pa la nye ring med cing*/ bem pos yul rig pa mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pas so// 'di la mkhas pa blo gros mtshungs med kyis lta dang ces sogs 'dod tshul snga ma gsum phyi rol pa gsum gyi 'dod pa yin pa tshad ma mdo'i rang 'grel na gsal bar yod/ 'dod tshul bzhi pa bye brag smra ba'i 'dod par bod rnams 'chad kyang*/ rgya gzhung na dngos su bkod pa med ces kha mtshon gcod par mdzad mod/ bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa ni// mdzod kyi de phyogs sngar bzhes nas 'dir bsnan pa yin pas/

tshad ma'i rgya gzhung gi bstan bcos na yod med rag ma las mod/ yang le'u gnyis par/ blo ni tshad ma nyid/ blang dang dor bya'i dngos po yis// 'jug la de gtso yin phyir dang*// zhes sogs gzhung gis dbang po gzugs can pa tshad mar byed pa'i chod pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'dod pa'i phyogs snga ma bkag nas/ rang lugs gzhal bya rtogs pa'i blo kho na tshad mar sgrub te/ ma chod pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ston par byed pa lha'i 'grel par gsal bar yod la/ de ltar na skabs 'dir phyogs snga ma bye brag tu smra ba la ngos 'dzin nam mi 'dzin/ (567) 'dzin na tshad ma'i rgya gzhung na med pa yang rtags ma grub la/ mi 'dzin na phyogs snga ma de gang yin yid chas pa'i gtan tshigs dang bcas pa smra dgos so// gsum pa la gsum te/ gzhan lugs dgag rang lugs bzhag skabs su babs pa'i dogs pa dpyad pa'o// dang po ni/ kha cig sngon po gzhal bya rang yul gyi rnam pa shar ba'i sgo nas sngon po la gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa tshad ma/ sngon po dngos su rtogs pa'i tshad ma 'bras bu/ zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin zer ba dang*/ yang kha cig sngon po gzhal bya/ sngon po rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa tshad ma/ sngon po rtogs pa'i mngon sum 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin zer ba dang*/ yang kha cig sngon po gzhal bya/ rang gi gzung don du gyur pa'i sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa tshad ma/ sngon po rtogs pa'i don rig 'bras bu/ zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin zer ba rnams mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ sngon po rtogs pa'i rjes dpag chos (568) can/ 'bras bu der thal/ tshad ma de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod la sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba gang zhig khyod sngon po la gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir/
