dang po ma grub na/ sngon po rtogs pa'i rjes dpag chos can/ khyod la sngon po'i rnam pa shar bar thal/ khyod la sngon po'i bag chags kyi dbang gis rnam pa shar ba'i phyir te/ khyod sngon po 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ der thal/ sngon po la tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ sngon po rtogs pa'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ sngon po dngos su rtogs pa'i tshad ma ma yin par thal/ sngon po don spyi'i tshul gyi rtogs pa'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ sngon po rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa yin par thal/ sngon po rtogs pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos thams cad rtogs pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ khyod la sngon po'i rnam pa ma shar ba'i phyir te/ sngon po rnam med rjen char du rtogs pa'i tshad ma yin (569) pa'i phyir te/ chos thams cad rnam med rjen char du rtogs pa'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ dam bca' gsum pa yang mi 'thad de/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po chos can/ sngon po rtogs pa'i don rig yin par thal/ rang gi gzung don du gyur pa'i sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod kyi gzung don du gyur pa'i sngon po yod pa gang zhig shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ sngon po de khyod kyi rtogs bya yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon po de khyod kyi gzhal bya yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon po chos can/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon skad cig ma dang po'i gzung don yin par thal/

'dod pa gang zhig phyi don yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon po skad cig ma dang po yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod du gyur pa'i sngon po skad cig ma gnyis pa sogs med par thal lo// yang kha cig sngon po

(570) gzhal bya/ sngon po rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa tshad ma/ sngon po rtogs pa'i mngon sum 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ 'o na de 'dra'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ khyod de phyir gzhal bya rtogs pa yi// sgrub byed gzhal bya'i rang bzhin nyid// ces pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi de yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'bras bu yin na/ don rig mngon sum yin pas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon po rtogs pa'i mngon sum chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ (571) ma grub na/ der thal/ sngon po de tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzhal bya yin pa gang zhig sngon po de'i rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa de de'i tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod du gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen med par thal/ khyod don rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang rnam mkhyen chos can/ sngon po rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa yin par thal/ sngon po rtogs pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa shag rtags sla/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ sngon po de khyod la rang ngos nas rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi phyi don yin par thal/

khyod sngon po rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon po de khyod kyi bzung don yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen gyi gzung don yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ khyod kyi bzung don med par thal/ khyod rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig sngon po lkog na mo gzhal bya/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi (572) sngon 'dzin dbang mngon la sngon po lkog na mos rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis sngon po lkog na mo rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de 'bras rtogs dang po'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i nang nas mdo sde pa'i thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin te/ rang 'grel las/ mdo sde pa'i don lkog na mo gzhal bya/ don dang 'dra bar skyes pa'i shes pa tshad ma don rtogs btags ba pa'i tha snyad 'bras bur 'dod pas gzhal bya dang*/ tshad 'bras dus dang ngo bo tha dad yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ gzhan dag bden grub kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sngon po lkog na mo gzhal bya tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon la des rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon des de rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras dang po'i bstan bya'i gtso bo dang*/ mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad (573) 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ dam bca' dang po de la/ sngon po lkog na mo gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de chos can/ khyod khas len gyi ngo bo nyid med par smra ba med par thal/ khyod grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong min par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/

rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod khas len gyi de yod par thal/ khyod khas len gyi mdo sde spyod pa'i ngo bo nyid med par smra ba yod pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzhal bya khas len gyi de yod pa gang zhig khyod kyi de'i nang tshan gyi tshad ma khas len gyi de yang yod/ khyod kyi de'i nang mtshan gyi 'bras bu khas len gyi de yang yod pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs rim bzhin grub ste/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed de de yin pa'i phyir ro// dam bca' gnyis pa la/ bden grub kyi khyad par byas pa'i sngon po lkog na mo gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum ka mdo sde pas thun mong (574) ma yin par khas len par thal/ khyod mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan gyi gzhal bya de yang mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden grub kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sngon po lkog na mo de mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mdo sde pa kho nas khas len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de khas len gyi gang zag yin na/ mdo sde pa yin dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bden grub kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sngon po lkog na mo mi rtag par sgrub pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag 'phen yul du gyur pa'i phyi rol pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de rtag mi rtag la dpyad pa byed pa'i gnas skabs kyi rgol ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rnam 'grel las/ dpyad pa nyid kyi skabs kyis ni// rab grags rten ni grub 'gyur te// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs grub te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/

(575) yang kha cig gzugs gzhal bya/ gzugs kyis rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba'i shes pa tshad ma/ gzugs gzung don du byas nas rtogs pa'i mngon sum 'bras bu/ zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin zer ba yang*/ don gyi go babs la de ltar 'thad kyang*/ tshig la 'khris na/ gzugs kyis rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ 'bras bu der thal/ tshad ma de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod la gzugs kyis rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba gang zhig shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ der thal/ bdag med yin na/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod kyi rnam pa shar dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod bsla/ kha cig tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dngos bstan kyis tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab/ mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi (576) rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab/ don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab/ yang rtags de yin na/ sems tsam pas khas mi len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab/ zer na/ mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ sgra mi rtag pa gzhal bya/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag la sgra mi rtag pa'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ des de rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan pa'i phyir te/ sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/

rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan ma yin par thal/ rnam 'grel gyi tshad 'bras dang po'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin/ gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin/ bzhi pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ de ma yin par thal/ don rig mngon sum (577) gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rjes dpag tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa ma grub na/ mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas sems tsam pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra mi rtag pa sems tsam pas khas len par thal lo// gsum pa ma grub na/ mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ ma grub de'i phyir/ yang de 'dra'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dngos bstan gyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan ma yin par thal/ tshad 'bras ston byed kyi rnam 'grel gyi gzhung rnams kyi shugs bstan gyi tshad 'bras rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir te/ rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ khyab te/ rnam 'grel gyi dngos bstan la mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras las/ rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras dngos su ma bstan la/ rigs gter las/ rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras yang dngos su bstan pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/ dam bca' gnyis (578) pa la/ bzung don can gyi dbang mngon gzhal bya/ de nyams su myong ba'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de gnyis kyi nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong min par khas len pa'i rang rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir te/

rang rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan gang zhig khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum sems tsam pas khas mi len pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ gzung don can gyi dbang mngon chos can/ khyod gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de rang rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ khyod gnyis snang can gyi shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab te/ rnam 'grel las/ gzhal bya 'jal byed 'bral gnas pa// 'di ni kun la sbyar bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ de der thal/ gzungs don sems tsam pas khas mi len pa'i phyir te/ phyi don sems tsam pas khas mi len pa'i phyir/ (579) rtsa bar 'dod na/ don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ dam bca' phyi ma gnyis la/ tha snyad du sngon po gzhal bya/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon la tha snyad du sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis tha snyad du sngon po rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ dbang mngon gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan gang zhig khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'bras bu de dbang mngon yin pa'i phyir/ thal ba dang po la rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/

ma yin par thal/ mdo sems thun mong du khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad (580) ldan yin pa'i phyir te/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan gang zhig khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum ga mdo sems gnyis kas khas len pa'i phyir/ thal ba gnyis pa la rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ sems tsam pas khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin par thal/ khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum re re nas sems tsam pas khas len pa gang zhig khyod tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ des na tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na yang*/ rnam 'grel gyi tshad 'bras bzhi po gang rung gi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas ma khyab te/ tha snyad du sngon po gzhal bya zhes sogs bshad ma thag pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yang ma yin/ gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin/ gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin/ bzhi pa'i dngos bstan gyi de yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs re re nas grub te/ mdo sems thun mong du khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gal te gsum pa'i dngos bstan mdo sems thun mong du khas len (581) par kun mkhyen bla mas bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ tshig gi rang ldog la 'khris na thun mong du khas len pa ltar snang bas/ zhib tu ma brtag pa dag gi snang ngor bden mod kyang*/ kun mkhyen nyid kyi dgongs pa ni tshad 'bras dang po'i 'bras bu la dogs pa bcad de/ mdo sde pa'i lugs la sbyar ba gcig dang*/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras kyi 'bras bu la dogs pa bcad de/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la sbyar ba gcig dang rnam pa gnyis su yod pas/ rnam pa kun tu mdo sde pa kho na yang ma yin/ sems tsam pa kho na yang ma yin par mdo sems gnyis ka'i lugs so sor sbyar du yod pa'i don yin te/

sde bdun rab gsal las/ gzhal bya gnyis ka la sbyar ba ni/ mdo sde pa'i lugs la phyi don lkog na mo gzhal bya dang*/ rnam rig pa'i lugs la phyi don med mod/ tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar 'thad pa'i tshul sngar bshad zin pas 'dis kyang gnyis ka'i lugs su grub bo// gsum pa yang sgra gnyis ka la sbyar ba ni/ mdo sde pa la sbyar ba'i tshe gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bur ma zad/ phyi don gzhal bya la yang zhes sbyar la/ rnam rig pa la sbyar ba'i tshe/ rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe phyi don med mod/ tha snyad du phyi don (582) yod na yang zhes sbyar bar bya ba yin pas/ 'dis kyang gnyis ka'i lugs su grub bo// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa 'di dag gis/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i tshad 'bras gzhal gsum ga la mdo sems kyi lugs so sor phye nas bshad 'dug pa'i phyir/ gal te thun mong du khas blangs pas chog na mdo sde pa la sbyar ba'i tshe dang*/ rnam rig pa la sbyar ba'i tshe zhes so sor smros pa don med par 'gyur te/ 'bras rtogs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ mdo sems thun mong du khas len pas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ lan ci gsungs/ gnyis ka'i lugs su grub bo zhes pa'i don ni/ mkhas pa snga ma'i bzhed pa ltar gyi mdo sems gang rung gcig kho na la mi sbyor bar gnyis ka'i lugs la sbyor la/ sbyor tshul thun mong du mi sbyor bar so sor ma 'dres par sbyor ba yin te/ tshad 'bras dang po'i dogs dpyod la sbyar ba na mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras zhig byung*/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dogs gcod la sbyar ba na/ mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas sems tsam pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag zhig byung ba yin

(583) pa'i phyir/ gnad 'di dag dang gong gi thal 'gyur gyi rigs pa'i phreng ba 'di dag ni/ yongs 'dzin dam pa dbang phyug dpal bzang gi zhal rgyun las byung ba rang gi blo la zhib tu 'jags pa rnams bris pa'o// gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ de phyir gzhal bya rtogs pa yi// sgrub byed gzhal bya'i rang bzhin nyid// ces pa'i tshig zur gzhal bya zhes pas gzhal bya dang*/ rtogs pa zhes pas 'bras bu dang*/ gzhal bya'i rang bzhin nyid ces pas tshad ma bstan pa yin pas/ skabs don tshan gzhi ni/ sngon po gzhal bya/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gzung don sngon po'i stobs las sngon po'i rnam ldan du skyes pa tshad ma/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis sngon po rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ni/ 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan tsam gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan dang*/ mdo sems gnyis ka'i nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i don rig mngon sum gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin te/ 'di la dgongs nas/ chos mchog gis/ don gzhal bya/ don dang 'dra ba tshad ma/ don rtogs pa 'bras bu/ zhes pa ni dang po'o// (584) zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rang 'grel las kyang*/ mdo sde pas don lkog na mo gzhal bya zhes sogs sngar drangs pa de'i phyir/ tshad 'bras de nyid gtan tshigs su bkod na/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngo 'dzin dbang mngon chos can/ khyod kyis sngon po rtogs pa yin te/ gzung don sngon po'i stobs las sngon po'i rnam ldan du skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o// tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub tu byed na/ sgrub chos de la rang gi gzung don sngon po rtogs pa yin zhes pa sbyar ro// yang phyi rol don du gyur pa'i lkog na mo sngon po bden grub pa gzhal bya/ de 'dzin pa'i tshur mthong gi dbang mngon la des rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/

de 'dzin pa'i tshur mthong dbang mngon gyis de rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i nang nas mdo sde pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i don rig gi tshad 'bras yin te/ de yang phyi rol du zhes pas sems tsam pa gcod/ lkog na mo zhes pas bye brag tu smra ba gcod/ bden grub pa zhes pas ngo bo nyid med par smra ba gcod nus pa'i phyir/ lkog na mo bye smras khas (585) mi len pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lkog na mo'i don rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyu la 'jog pas/ rang 'dzin tshur mthong gi don rig mngon sum la rang ngos nas rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed kyi rgyur gyur pa'i phyi don la phyi don lkog na mor 'jog rigs zhing*/ de bye smras khas mi len te/ bye smras blo la don gyi rnam pa gtad pa'am shar ba rnams khas mi len pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs su babs pa'i dogs pa dpyad pa ni/ kha cig shes pa yin na/ khyod la rang yul gyi rnam pa shar bas khyab te/ rigs gter las/ rang la shar na rang yul yin// ma shar na ni de yul min// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ kha cig tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis sngon po 'dzin na/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i sngon po 'dzin nam/ rang gi snga logs su byung ba'i sngon po 'dzin/ dang po ltar na/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i sngon po dmigs rkyen du byas nas 'dzin par thal/ de 'dzin pa gang zhig de las gzhan pa'i 'dzin tshul mi 'dug pa'i phyir te/ don rig mngon sum gyis phyi don 'dzin pa thams cad dmigs rkyen gyi dbang du byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na rang dang dus mnyam pa'i (586) dmigs rkyen yod par 'gyur bas rgyu 'bras dus mnyam par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ltar na/ rang gi snga logs su 'byung ba'i sngon po mi 'dzin par thal/

rang gi snga logs su byung ba'i sngon po dngos med du gyur zin pa'i phyir te/ rang gi snga logs su byung ba'i sngon po 'gags zin pa'i phyir/ yang rang 'grel las/ don rtogs btags pa ba'i tha snyad 'bras bur 'dod pas zhes gsungs pa'i tshig zin la brten/ paṇa chen gyis/ mdo sde pa'i grub pa'i mtha' mthar thug pa la don snang gi shes pas phyi rol gyi don rig par khas mi len pa'i phyir zhes don dang 'dra ba de 'bras bu rang rig gcig pu'i sgrub byed du khas len pa dang*/ phyi rol gyi don khas len pa na/ phyi don gzhal bya la rang rig mtshan nyid pa dang*/ don rig btags pa ba'i tha snyad 'bras bur 'jog pa/ mdo sde pa rang lugs yin pa de nyid bstan bcos 'dir phyi rol gyi don sgrub pa'i skabs su rang lugs mthar thug pa'o// zhes bkod do// 'di dag ni mkhas pas dpyad par bya ba'i dogs pa yin pas/ rim pa bzhin du dpyad par bya bas gsan cig dang po la dbang mngon gyi gzung rnam nyams su myong ba'i 'dzin rnam chos can/ khyod la de'i gzung rnam gyi (587) rnam pa shar bar thal/ khyod de yul du byed pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ rnam pa thug med du shar ba thal/ de la de'i rnam pa shar na dbang mngon gyi gzung rnam gyi rnam pa nyams su myong ba'i 'dzin rnam la de'i gzung rnam gyi rnam pa'i rnam pa shar dgos pa sogs grangs dang mu med du khas len dgos byung ba'i phyir/ des na yul rtogs pa la yul gyi rnam pa shar dgos par bshad pa ni/ gzhan rig gi shes pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyis/ shes pa thams cad kyi dbang du byas pa ma yin te/ rnam pa shar ba la gzhal bya'i rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba dang*/ bag chags kyi dbang gis rnam pa shar ba dang*/ bdag rkyen dbang po bslad pa'i sgo nas rnam pa shar ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ don rig mngon sum kho na dang*/ gnyis pa ni rtog pa thams cad/

gsum pa ni dbang shes 'khrul pa rnams yin par shes dgos par bya'o// zhes kun mkhyen bla mas gsungs pa ni gnad kyi don no// dbang shes 'khrul pas mtshon nas rtog med yid shes 'khrul pa rnams la dbang po bslad pa'i sgo nas rnam pa shar ba khas len dgos so// dogs pa gnyis pa la dpyad pa ni/ rgyu 'bras la brten pa'i dus snga phyi'i rigs pa de dag ni dpyad pa'i rigs par (588) song bas tha snyad khas len gyi skabs su 'jug pa ma yin te/ dpal ldan zla bas/ gang phyir dngos po 'di dag rnam dpyad na// de nyid bdag can dngos las tshu rol du// gnas snyed ma yin de phyir 'jig rten gyi// tha snyad bden la rnam par dpyad mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// des na bu gzugs pha'i gzugs dang 'dra bar skyes pa la pha'i gzugs 'dzin zhes brjod pa ltar dbang mngon yid mngon gnyis don dang 'dra bar skyes pa la don rtogs par 'jog pa 'jig rten na grags pa ltar gyi tha snyad khas blangs nas phyi rol don sgrub par mdzad pa mdo sde'i lugs mchog yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ des de nyid don btang snyoms can// glang chen gzigs stangs nyid mdzad nas// 'jig rten thugs ni 'ba' zhig gis// phyi rol dpyod la 'jug pa mdzad// zhes dang*/ gal te phyi rol spyod la 'jug pa na// kho bo mdo sde'i skabs la rnam par brten// zhes dang*/ rab dbye las kyang*/ thub pas 'jig rten mthun 'jug la// dgongs nas phyi rol don du gsungs// zhes gsungs pas so// dogs pa gsum pa la dpyad pa ni/ don rtogs btags pa ba'i don la/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis/ don rnam med du ma rtogs pas btags pa ba zhes bshad/ kun mkhyen g.yag pas (589) phyi rol gyi don gzhal bya/ ma dpyad na don rig par snang yang*/ dpyad na rang rig 'bras bu zhes bshad rang lugs kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs pa yang de dang don gnad gcig par snang bas blo gsal dag gis tshul de bzhin du bskyangs par bya la/

paṇa chen gyis phyi don gzhal bya la rang rig mtshan nyid pa 'bras bur mdzad nas don rtogs brtags pa ba dngos su 'jog pa phyi don sgrub pa'i skabs su mdo sde pa'i rang lugs mthar thug yin gsungs pa ha cang thal te/ mdo sde pa'i rang lugs mthar thug de ci 'dra zhig yin/ khyed ltar na kho rang gi rang lugs mthar thug gis kho rang gi rang lugs kyi gnad 'gog nus par 'gyur te/ phyi don gzhal bya la gzung rnam tshad ma/ don rig 'bras bur byas te don rig mngon sum gyis don rang mtshan rtogs par sgrub pa ni/ mdo sde pa'i skabs 'dir phyi don sgrub byed kyi rigs pa'i gtso bo yin pa las/ khyed kyi de las bzlog ste phyi don gzhal bya la rang rig mtshan nyid pa 'bras bur byas nas/ don rig 'bras bur mi byed pa de mdo sde pa'i rang lugs mthar thug tu zhal gyi bzhes pa'i phyir/ gnad kyi don ni/ mkhas 'jug las/ phyi rol dpyod na mdo sde pa'i// grub mtha' dngos po (590) stobs shugs yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i skabs la brten pa na/ don snang gi shes pa la don gyi rnam pa ma shar ba'i bye smra'i lugs bkag nas/ phyi don lkog na mo rigs pas sgrub par mdzad pa yin la/ de yang 'jal byed don rig mngon sum gyis/ gzhal bya phyi don rtogs pa'i sgrub byed tshad 'bras dang po'i rigs pa 'di dag bkod pas khas len gyi gtso bo phyi don lkog na mo 'bad med du 'grub te/ mdo sde pa'i grub mtha'i gzhung tshugs pa yin no// mdor na 'bras rtogs dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ khyod kyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang mtshan gyi tshad ma dang 'bras bu gnyis po de rang rgyu phyi don las byung bas khyab/ phyi don gzhal byar byed pas khyab/ don rig mngon sum mtshan nyid pa 'bras bur byed pas khyab pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/

phyi don las byung don rig tshad 'bras bshad// ces rdo rje'i tshig bka' stsal de nyid kyi don 'khrul pa mi snang bas so// 'bras bu don rtogs bya ba sgrub byed kyi// tshad ma byed po gzhal bya las yin pas// tshad 'bras nyid la bya byed las gsum gyi// rnam gzhag kun btus tshigs bcad de yis bstan// (591) tshad 'bras rdzas gzhan 'dod pa mu stegs lugs// tshad 'bras bdag nyid gcig sgrub mdo sems lugs// bye brag smra ba'ang rdzas gzhan 'dod pas na// rigs gter gzhung du rdzas gzhan lugs bzhi bshad// rnam 'grel gzhung du phyi rol pa yi lugs// ston phyir spyod pa ba sogs rnam gsum bshad// don de ma go bye smra'i 'dod pa ni// rgya gzhung med ces gnas drug pa sogs rtsod// rang lugs phyi don gzhal bya phyi don gyis// rang ngos rang 'dra'i rnam shar tshad ma dang*// phyi don rtogs pa'i don rig 'bras bu ni// tshad 'bras dang po'i bstan don legs par grub// kha cig don snang shes pa phyi rol don// rtogs par mi bzhed phyi don gzhal bya la// don rig brtags pa ba nyid 'bras bu zhes// mdo sde pa yis grub mtha'i gnad bkag nas// mdo sde'i rang lugs mthar thug yin no lo// gsung gi rnga dbyangs mthon po sgrog mdzad kyang*// don rig mngon sum nyid kyis don rtogs pa// mdo sde'i rang lugs snying por bzhed na legs// tshad 'bras dang po bstan zin to// //gnyis pa rnam rig smra ba'i tshad 'bras la gsum ste/ mdo las ji ltar gsungs pa'i (592) tshul/ rnam 'grel las ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ de dag gi don gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ mdor yang na rang rig 'bras bu ste zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ shes pa ni gnyis su snang ba ste/ rang gi snang ba dang yul gyi snang ba'o// snang ba de gnyis las gang rang rig pa ni 'bras bu'o// zhes pa 'dis gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bur byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag bstan pas rnam bden pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras dang po bstan don ni gzhal bya dang bcas pa zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyi skabs su don rig 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras bshad pa de las yang na/

phyi don bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur sgrub ste shes bya nang la 'jug pa yin no// zhes ston pa la/ yang na rang rig 'bras bu ste/ zhes pa byung*/ 'o na rang rig de'i gzhal bya gang*/ shes pa gang rang rig pa la 'di'i 'bras bur 'jog pa yin zhe na/ spyir gzhal bya'i shes pa la gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba yod de/ shes pa rang gi snang ba 'dzin rnam dang*/ yul gzhan gyi snang ba gzung ba'i rnam pa'o// zhes ston pa la/ shes pa ni gnyis su snang ba ste/ rang gi snang ba dang yul gyi snang ba'o// zhes pa byung*/ snang ba gzung 'dzin gyi (593) rnam pa de gnyis las/ gzung rnam gang yin pa ni 'dir gzhal bya dang*/ de rang gi rig byar rig pa ni skabs 'di'i 'bras bu yin no// zhes ston pa la/ snang ba de gnyis las gang rang rig pa ni 'bras bu'o// zhes pa byung*/ de ltar na gang zhes pas gzhal bya dang*/ rang rig pa ni/ zhes pas 'bras bu dngos su bstan no// tshad ma don thob pa la bstan pa yin no// yang mdor 'di'i ngo bo las don nges zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ gang gi tshe shes pa yul dang bcas pa don yin pa de'i tshe/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rang rig pa las 'dod pa'am mi 'dod pa'i don rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes pa 'dis/ tha snyad du phyi don gzhal bya la tha snyad du don rig 'bras bur byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag bstan pas/ rnam bden pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras gnyis pa zhig bstan pa yin no// don ni sngon por snang ba la sogs pa gang gi shes pa rang dus su yul sngon po sogs dang bcas pa ste/ sngon po sogs su snang ba'i gzung rnam tha snyad du gzhal bya phyi don yin pa de'i tshe/ 'bras bu yang tha snyad du don rig pa yin no// zhes ston pa la/ gang (594) gi tshe shes pa yul dang bcas pa don yin pa de'i tshe/ zhes pa byung*/ bshad ma thag pa'i gzhal bya de dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'jal byed don la rang rig yin pa'i tshad ma de las 'dod pa tha snyad du mdzes pa'i gzugs sogs dang*/

mi 'dod pa tha snyad du mi mdzes pa'i gzugs sogs kyi don rtogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ tshad ma de'i dbang las/ tha snyad du 'dod mi 'dod sogs kyis phyi don rtogs pa ni/ skabs 'dir tshad ma'i 'bras bu yin pas so// zhes ston pa la/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rang rig pa las 'dod pa'am mi 'dod pa'i don rtogs par 'gyur ro// zhes pa byung*/ de ltar na shes pa yul dang bcas pa don yin pa zhes pas gzhal bya dang*/ rang rig pa las zhes pas tshad ma dang*/ 'dod pa'am mi 'dod pa'i don rtogs par zhes pas 'bras bu bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa rnam 'grel las bstan tshul la/ dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur bstan pa/ rtsa 'grel gyi don 'grel ba dang tha snyad du don rig 'bras bur bstan pa rtsa 'grel gyi don 'grel ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mdo sde pas/ sngor snang dbang shes pa sogs la rang dus su sngo sogs su snang ba de sngon po sogs kyis rang ngos nas (595) rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtad pa'i 'bras bu yin pa bkag nas/ rang rig 'bras bur ston par byed pa la/ don rig gang yin so sor rig ces pa nas/ des na gzhan rig med pa'i phyir// rang rig 'bras bu yin par 'dod ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum dang*/ sa bcad las kyang*/ snang ba don 'bras yin pa bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur sgrub/ ces pa byung*/ yang bye brag smra bas sngor snang dbang shes sogs la rang dus su sngo sogs su snang bde phyi don sngon po sogs su 'dod pa la de bkag nas/ bzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig ces pa byung*/ yang bye brag smra bas sngor snang dbang shes sogs la rang dus su sngo sogs su snang ba de phyi don sngon po sogs su 'dod pa la de bkag nas/ bzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bu ston par byed pa la/ gal te phyi rol myong gyur na// zhes pa nas/ 'di yi rnam pa gnyis/ myong ba nyid ni 'bras bu yin// zhes pa'i bar tshigs bcad lnga dang*/

sa bcad las kyang*/ snang ba phyi don yin pa bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur sgrub/ ces pa byung*/ bod snga ma dag snang ba phyi don du 'dod pa'i phyogs snga 'di mdo sde pa la sbyar nas bshad kyang kun mkhyen chen pos 'di bye brag tu smra ba'i 'dod pa yin par bshad nas/ dbang shes la rang dus su snang ba'i rnam pa phyi don gyi 'bras bu yin pa bkag nas/ rang rig 'bras bu dang*/ rnam pa nyid

(596) phyi don yin pa bkag nas rang rig 'bras bur sgrub pa'i bshad pa gnyis snang ba ni sngon med kyi bshad pa phul du phyin pa dang*/ gzhung dang yang shin tu 'byor te/ snga ma'i don bsdur des na gzhan rigs sogs tshig rkang gnyis dang*/ phyi ma'i don bsdur myong ba nyid ni 'bras bu yin zhes pa 'byung bas kyang*/ de ltar du gsal ba'i phyir/ gzhan du na grub don de gnyis zlos pa'am/ phyi ma de grub zin sgrub par 'gyur te/ khyed ltar na mdo sde pa nyid kyang rang rig 'bras bur sgrub tshul lan gnyis song bas so// sngon por snang ba mthong ba yin// phyi rol yan gar don yod min// zhes pa'i rigs pa yang bye brag smra ba'i ngor 'grig pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ bye brag tu smra bas sngor snang dbang shes la rang dus su sngon por snang ba phyi don du 'dod pas/ de'i ngor de 'gog byed kyi rigs pa bstan dgos la/ mdo sde pas de ltar mi 'dod pas/ mdo sde pa la de 'gog byed kyi rigs pa ston mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de yi ngo bo las don nges// zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa 'grel ba la/ gang tshe rnam rig rgyu yi zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum byung*/ de yang gang tshe rnam rig zhes pa'i rnam (597) rig ni bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes sogs yin zhing*/ rgyu yi yul zhes pa ni sngor snang dbang shes sogs kyi snang ba'i dmigs rkyen du gyur pa'i gzhal bya tha snyad du phyi don de yin pas/ sngor snang dbang shes kyi rgyu btags pa ba yin te/ de ni/ sngor snang dbang shes sogs dang dus mnyam pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang mngon gyi snang ba'i dmigs rkyen yin na de'i dmigs rkyen ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ des na tshig rkang dang po de ni gzhal bya ston byed dang*/ gzhan 'dod pa'am mi 'dod pa/ de yi dngos por ma grub pa/ de ni zhes pa tshad ma ston byed dang*/

de ltar myong ba yin zhes pa 'bras bu ston byed yin pas/ tshigs bcad dang pos tshad 'bras gzhal gsum ka dngos su bstan/ gang tshe shes cha don du ni/ gzhag phyir zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis pas tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi gzhal bya phyi don de shes pa yin par bstan pa yin te/ nang shes pa'i char gyur pa'i bzung rnam la dbang shes kyis drangs nas skyes pa'i rjes kyi nges shes kyis/ phyi don du tha snyad byed pas tha snyad du phyi don du bzhag kyang*/ don la shes pa yin pa'i phyir// de (598) skad du/ dmigs rtag las kyang*/ nang gi shes bya'i ngo bo ni// phyi rol ltar snang gang yin te// don nyid rnam shes ngo bo'i phyir// zhes gsungs so// don nyid ces pa tha snyad du/ phyi don yin pa dang*/ rnam shes ngo bo'i phyir zhes pas don la shes pa yin par bstan/ gal te 'di bdag 'dod rnam dang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum pas kyang*/ tshad ma dang 'bras bu dngos su bstan pa yin te/ 'dir 'dod pa'i ma 'dod pa des kyang zhes pa dang*/ mdor de yi ngo bo las zhes pa don gnad gcig pas tshad ma bstan/ 'dir don rig par ni 'gyur ba yin zhes dang*/ mdor don des zhes pa don gnad gcig pas 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ de yi ngo bo zhes pa'i ngo bo yang sngor snang dbang shes sogs kyi ngo bo bzung rnam la bya rigs pas so// gsum pa de dag gi don gtan la dbab pa la/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ don dam rang rig tshad 'bras bshad// tha snyad don rig tshad 'bras bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ don dam rang rig gi tshad 'bras dang*/ tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras gnyis/ dang po la/ kha cig shes pa rang gi bdag nyid gzhal bya/ 'dzin rnam tshad ma rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad (599) 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de spyir rang rig gi tshad 'bras dang*/ gzung rnam gzhal bya/ 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos stan gyi rang rig gi tshad 'bras dang*/

sngor snang dbang shes kyi bzung rnam gzhal bya/ de'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ dang po la/ shes pa rang gi bdag nyid chos can/ khyod tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzhal bya yin par thal/ khyod gzhal byar byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ gnyis snang can gyi shes pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab te/ gnyis snang spangs pa'i shes pa yin na/ khyod gzhal byar byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag med pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ rang rig tshad 'bras shes pa kun la sbyar bar gsungs pa yang gnyis snang can gyi shes pa la dgongs (600) pa yin pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ khyod dang gnyis snang spangs pa'i shes pa'i gzhi mthun med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de'i gzhi thun yod par thal/ rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi ngo bo de de yin pa'i phyir/ dam bca' gnyis pa la/ 'o na bzung rnam de tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i gzhal bya yin par thal/ gzung rnam gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ gzung rnam chos can/ rang gi 'jog gzhi dbang mngon dang yid mngon gang rung gi gzung rnam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab te/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi gzhal byar gyur pa'i bzung rnam de la rtog pa sogs shes pa gzhan gyi bzung rnam ma bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod dang rtog pa'i gzung rnam gyi gzhi mthun med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de la/ sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/

khyod mdo sems gnyis kyi (601) nang nas sems tsam pas thun mong ma yin par khas len par thal ba dang*/ rnam bden brdzun gnyis kyi nang nas rnam bden pas thun mong ma yin par khas len par thal/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ thal ba dang po la 'dod na/ khyod mdo sde pas khas mi len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyi gzung rnam gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de yang khas mi len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mdo sde pa'i lugs la dbang mngon gyi gzung rnam gzhal byar byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag med par thal lo// thal ba gnyis pa la/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod rnam rdzun pas khas mi len par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam gzhal bya zhes sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de/ rnam rdzun pas khas len pa'i phyir te/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam de rnam rdzun pas khas len pa gang zhig de rnam rdzun pas khas len na/ de gzhal byar byed (602) pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyang rnam rdzun pas khas len dgos pa'i phyir te/ bzung ba 'dzin pa rig pa dag /ces sogs kyi bstan don rnam rdzun pas khas len pa'i phyir/ rang gi lugs ni/ rang 'grel las/ sems tsam pa'i ltar na/ gzung ba 'dzin pa rig pa dag /yod pa min yang gzhal bya la// 'jal byed 'bras bur gnas pa 'di// ji ltar rjes su snang bzhin byas// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnam bcas pa dag /bzung bar snang ba gzhal bya de 'dzin par snang ba tshad ma/ rang rig mtshan nyid pa 'bras bur 'dod pas/ gzhal bya dang*/ tshad 'bras bde sdug myong ba ltar dus dang ngo bo gcig tu 'dod do// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes ma 'khrul ba'i gzung rnam gzhal bya/

gzung rnam de yongs su gcod pa'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ gzung rnam de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan tsam gyi rang rig gi tshad 'bras dang*/ sems tsam rnam bden rdzun gnyis kas thun mong du khas len pa'i gzhi mthun yin te/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan tsam 'di rnam rdzun pas kyang khas len (603) pa'i phyir te/ bden grub kyi khyad par ma sbyar ba'i sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam sogs gsum po de rnam brdzun pas khas len pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par du sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam ni bden rdzun gang la bden par yod med rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i rtsod gzhi'i chos can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang khas len rigs pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ kun mkhyen chen pos rnam bshad kun bzang las kyang*/ rang rig gi tshad 'bras la thog mar rnam bden brdzun gnyis char gyis khas len pa'i tshad 'bras kyi skya ris ni/ mdo sde pa'i lugs bkag nas rnam rig pa'i lugs bsgrub pa ste/ don rig gang yin ces pa nas/ 'di yi rnam pa gnyis zhes pa'i bar/ zhes gsungs so// rnam bden rdzun gnyis kyi nang nas rnam dben pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs dang*/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras ni/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam bden grub pa gzhal bya/ de yongs su gcod par byed pa'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di yin te/ (604) bye mdo gnyis kyis bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes khas mi len/ rnam brdzun pa dang ngo bo nyid med par smra bas bzung rnam bden grub pa khas mi len pa'i phyir na/ rnam bden pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs su grub bo// de skad du/ myong ba nyid ni 'bras bu yin// zhes pa'i 'thad kyi lha'i 'grel par/

de ltar na bzung ba'i rnam pa ni gzhal bya yin zhing*/ bdag nyid nyams su myong ba ni 'bras bu yin la/ 'dzin pa'i rnam pa ni sgrub par byed pa yin pa de ltar na don med pa la 'bras bu'i rtog pa 'di ni gcig yin no// zhes gsungs so// don med pa la zhes pa ni/ phyi don gzhal byar med pa la zhes pa'i don yin te/ 'dir bzung rnam gzhal byar byas pa'i phyir ro// 'dir sems tsam rnam bden brdzun gyis phyi don dang*/ phyi don rig pa'i mngon sum khas mi len pas/ de gnyis don rig smra ba ji ltar 'thad// mi 'thad na/ don rig smra ba rang rang gi grub mtha'i stobs kyi tshad 'bras 'jog /ces pa rtsa 'grel dang 'gal lo/ zhe na rnam bden rdzun gnyis don rig smra ba ma yin yang*/ tha snyad du don rig khas len pas/ tha snyad du don rig smra ba yin pa la dgongs nas don rig smra ba rang rang gi zhes sogs rtsa 'grel (605) gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras la kha cig shes pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i sngon po gzhal bya/ de'i rnam pa shar nas de la gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa tshad ma/ de dngos su rtogs pa'i tshad ma 'bras bu zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ shes pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i sngon po med pa'i phyir te/ shes par gyur pa'i sngon po med pa'i phyir te/ shes pa dang sngon po'i gzhi thun med pa'i phyir/ gal te kho na re/ bag chag brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam la shes pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i sngon po zhes bya'o zhe na/ 'o na bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes de de'i gzung rnam la rang rig yin nam/ gzhan rig yin/ dang po ltar na/ de chos can/ khyod de la rang rig ma yin par thal/ khyod la de'i rnam pa shar ba'i phyir/ khyab te/ khyod chos de la rang rig yin na/ khyod la de'i rnam pa shar ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/

de'i rnam pa shar nas de la gsar du mi bslu ba'i rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ gzung rnam de dngos su rtogs pa'i tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blang dang tshad 'bras kyi steng du (606) song*/ rtags grub te/ gzung rnam de rtogs pa'i rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ gal te gnyis pa ltar de la gzhan rig yin no zhe na/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes de rang gi ngo bo la gzhan rig yin par thal/ de rang gi gzung rnam la gzhan rig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes pa thams cad rang gi ngo bo la rang rig mngon sum du bshad pa mi 'thad par thal lo/ yang kha cig tha snyad du sngon po gzhal bya/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes la tha snyad du sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ des tha snyad du sngon po rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes zer ba la yang*/ skyon de nyid gnas te/ 'o na bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes la rang gi gzung rnam gyi rnam pa shar bar thal/ de la tha snyad du sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba gang zhig tha snyad du sngon po ni sngor snang dbang shes kyi gzung rnam la 'jog pa'i phyir/ rtags dngapo khas/ gnyis pa grub te/ lhas bzung ba'i rnam pa la ni don du tha snyad 'dogs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de la rang gi gzung rnam gyi rnam pa shar bar thal/ de rang gi gzung rnam la rang rig mngon sum yin pa'i (607) phyir/ rang lugs ni/ tha snyad du phyi rol don du gyur pa'i sngon po gzhal bya/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes la sngon po gsal bar snang ba'i gzung rnam tshad ma/ tha snyad du phyi don sngon po rig pa'i don rig mngon sum 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de 'dir bstan tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin te/ gang tshe rnam rig rgyu yi yul zhes sogs kyi 'grel par lhas des na don dang 'dra ba ni tshad ma yin zhing*/

don myong ba ni 'bras bu yin pa de ltar na phyi rol gyi don yod pa'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis pa bshad pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sde bdun rab gsal las kyang*/ mtshan gzhi bshad ma thag pa de ltar du bzung bas so// 'di la yang gzhal bya dang 'jal byed tshad ma gcig tu thal ba'i dogs pa 'jug ste/ gzhal bya tha snyad du sngon po de bzung rnam la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir ro// lhas phyi rol gyi don yod pa'i rnam par rtog pa zhes pa yang tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par bzhag pa zhes pa'i don du 'chad dgos so// yang na tha snyad du sngon po gzhal bya/ bag chags brtan byung gi (608) sngor snang dbang shes la sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ des tha snyad du sngon po rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de 'dir bstan tha snyad du don rig gi 'bras kyi mtshan gzhir bzung na ji ltar 'thad mkhas pas dpyad par bya ste/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes la gzhal bya tha snyad du sngon po'i rnam pa ma shar kyang*/ spyir sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba tsam du khas blang na skyon cher med pa'i phyir te/ lhas don dang 'dra ba ni tshad ma yin zhing*/ zhes gsungs pas/ don snang gi dbang shes don dang 'dra bar zhal gyis bzhes la/ don dang 'dra na don gyi rnam pa shar dgos pa gzhi grub tu gsal ba'i phyir/ mdor na tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi tha snyad don rig gi tshad ma dang 'bras bu gang rung yin na/ bag chags brtan byung gi dbang mngon dang yid mngon gang rung yin pas khyab/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan gyi rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi gzhal bya yin na/ bag chags brtan byung gi dbang yid gang rung gi gzung rnam yin pas khyab/ de'i dngos bstan gyi rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi tshad ma dang 'bras bu gang rung yin na/ rang gi

(609) 'jog gzhi bag chags brtan byung gi dbang yid gang rung gi gzung rnam la bzhag pa'i tshad ma dang 'bras bu yin pas khyab pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ bag chags brtan byung rnam rig tshad 'bras bshad// ces pa'i rdo rje'i tshig bka' stsal pas so// phyi don 'jal byed don rig 'bras bu las// yang na gzung rnam nyams myong rig rig ni// 'bras bur byed pa'i rang rig tshad 'bras dang*// dbang shes ngo bo gzung rnam tshad ma las// tha snyad don rtogs tha snyad don rig gi /tshad 'bras gnyis su dbye ba rnam bden lugs// phyogs kyi glang pos legs bstan chos grags kyi// legs par bkral ba'i go rim ji bzhin yin// snang ba don 'bras bkag nas rang rig dang*// snang ba phyi don bkag nas rang rig ni// 'bras bur sgrub pa rim bzhin mdo sde dang*// bye smra'i lugs srol 'gog phyir bshad tshul gnyis// tha snyad don rig tshad 'bras gzhal bya la// tha snyad phyi don bshad kyang gzung rnam la// rjes kyi shes pas phyi don tha snyad phyir// shes pa'i bye brag cha la don du brtags// 'di la gzhal bya 'jal byed tshad ma gnyis// gcig tu thal te bzung rnam nyid phyir ro// snyam pa'i (610) dogs pa 'byung rigs dpyod ldan gyis// legs bshad gsar pa'i dga' ston stsol ba rigs// tshad 'bras 'di dag bag chags brtan byung gi /gzung rnam sogs dang de la 'jog gzhi'i phyir// bag chags brtan byung rnam rig tshad 'bras zhes// kun mkhyen bla mas bka' stsal rdo rje'i tshig /tshad 'bras gnyis pa bstan zin to// //gsum pa don rig gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa bcad nas dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur bstan pa la gsum ste/ mdo las ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul// rnam 'grel las ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ de dag gi don gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ mdo las gang gi tshe phyi rol gyi don 'ba' zhig gzhal byar byas pa de'i tshe/

yul du snang ba nyid de yi// tshad ma de yis 'jal bar byed// ji lta ji ltar yul gyi rnam pa dkar po dang*/ dkar po ma yin pa la sogs pa shes pa la snang ba na/ de dang de'i ngo bo yul dang bcas pa 'jal bar byed de/ de ltar rnam pa du ma rig pa'i shes pa du ma nye bar khas blangs pa de lta de ltar tshad ma gzhal bya nyid du nye bar 'dogs pa yin te/ chos thams cad ni bya ba dang bral ba'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'jog pa'i skabs gang gi tshe shes pa gzhal byar (611) ma byas par/ phyi don 'ba' zhig gzhal byar byas pa de'i tshe don snang gi shes pa la phyi rol yul du snang ba'i gzung rnam nyid tshad ma yin te/ bzung rnam de dang phyi don gzhal bya 'jal byed du 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa la/ gang gi tshe zhes pa nas 'jal bar byed ces pa'i bar byung*/ gzhal bya 'jal byed du 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ gzhal bya ci lta 'jal byed ji ltar yul gyi rnam pa dkar po dang*/ dkar po ma yin pa ser po la sogs pa don snang gi shes pa po la gsal bar snang ba'i phyir na/ don snang gi shes pa de dang de'i ngo bo yul dang bcas pa 'jal bar byed nus so zhes pa la/ ci lta ji ltar zhes pa nas/ 'jal bar byed ste zhes pa'i bar byung*/ 'jal bar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar na/ yul gyi rnam pa dkar po la sogs pa du ma rig pa'i don snang gi shes pa du ma nye bar khas blangs pa de lta de ltar don snang gi shes pa so so la don so sor snang ba'i gzung rnam ni tshad ma dang don so so ni gzhal bya nyid du tha snyad du nye bar 'dogs pa yin te/ dpyad na chos thams cad bya ba dang bral bas bya byed kyi rnam gzhag ni nges par tha snyad la brten pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa la/ de ltar rnam pa zhes pa nas bral ba'i phyir (612) zhes pa'i bar byung*/ 'dir phyi rol gyi don zhes pa dang*/ dkar po dang dkar po ma yin pa la sogs pa zhes bshad pa'i phyi don dang dkar po sogs ni mdo sde pa la sbyar ba na phyi don dngos dang*/

sems tsam pa la sbyar ba na tha snyad du/ phyi don dang dkar po sogs la 'chad dgos la/ de bzhin du phyi rol don ni yod na yang zhes sogs rnam 'grel gyi tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi gzhal bya phyi don rnams la yang mdo sems gnyis kyi 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba'i rnam dbye shes par bya'o// gnyis pa rnam 'grel las bstan tshul ni/ tshad 'bras dang por phyi don gzhal bya la don rig 'bras bur bstan pa dang*/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras kyi skabs su yang tha snyad du phyi don gzhal bya la tha snyad du don rig 'bras bur bstan pa la 'phros nas 'o na phyi don gzhal bya la don rig kho na 'bras bur nges sam zhe na/ gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bur ma zad/ phyi don gzhal bya la yang rang rig 'bras bur 'jog pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag rigs pa yin no// zhes pa ni/ phyi rol don ni yod na yang*// ji ltar nyams su myong nyid de// zhes dang*/ de phyir phyi rol gzhal bya la'ang*// rang nyid nyams myong 'bras yin rigs// (613) zhes pas bstan/ phyi don gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bur bzhag pa de'i tshe na 'dzin rnam tshad mar 'gyur ro// zhe na/ de'i tshe gzung rnam nyid tshad ma yin gyis/ 'dzin rnam ni ma yin te/ 'dzin rnam de gzhal bya phyi don gyi yul can ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ de tshe don snang 'di nyid na// tshad yin yod du zin kyang ni// don gzhan min phyir phyi rol la// 'dzin bdag ltos par bya ba min// zhes pas bstan/ 'o na skabs 'dir 'bras bu tshad ma dang yul tha dad par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de chos can/ tshad ma dang yul tha dad pa min te/ khyod dpyad na rang rig yin pa la tha snyad du don rig par 'dod pa'i phyir te/ khyod la snang ba'i gzung rnam de tha snyad du phyi don du 'jog cing*/ dpyad na shes pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ don 'jog de yi bdag nyid phyir// rang rig yin yang don rig 'dod// de phyir yul tha dad pa'ang min// zhes pas bstan/

'on sngar don rig 'bras bur bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ 'dir dpyad pa'i tshe na rang rig 'bras bur bshad pa yin zhing*/ sngar gyi don rig de yang dpyad na rang gi bdag nyid rig pa yin pa'i phyir/ (614) zhes pa ni/ rang gi ngo bo spyod pa na// rang rig 'bras bu yin par bshad// don rig de yi bdag nyid phyir// zhes pas bstan/ 'o na phyi don gzhal byar 'jog pa mi 'thad par thal/ tha snyad du phyi don rig pa tsam las ji lta ba bzhin du rig pa med pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ phyi don gyi rang ngos nas rang 'dra'i rnam pa shar ba'am/ gzhan bag chags kyi dbang gis rnam pa shar ba gang yin yin yang rung*/ phyi rol don ni gzhal bya nyid du byed pa yin te/ don snang gi shes pa la don gyi rang ngos nas rang 'dra'am gzhan bag chags gang rung gi rnam pa shar ba de'i rgyu ni/ gzhal bya phyi don nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ de dang 'dra'am gzhan 'dra'ang rung*// shes pa de ltar snang ba yin// rgyu ni don yang yin pas na// don ni gzhal bya nyid du 'dod// ces pas bstan/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i skabs don khag che ba'i gzhung gi snying po rnams de tsam du 'dus pas/ de tsam du bshad pa blo gsal dag gi snying la bcang bar bya zhing*/ don de sa bcad du dril na/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ rang rig 'bras bu yin par sgrub// gzung rnam tshad ma yin par sgrub// phyi don gzhal bya yin par bsgrub pa'o// ces don tshan gsum du tshad 'bras gsum pa'i bstan don thams cad bsdus te bshad (615) pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad par rtogs so// gsum pa de dag gi don bstan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi dpyad pa'i tshul/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs don bshad pa/ dgongs don gyi mtshan gzhi ngos bzung ba'o// dngapo ni/ mkhas pa'i bzhed lugs mi 'dra ba lnga tsam byung ba yin te/ kha cig tshad 'bras gsum pa ni sems tsam pas mdo sde pa dang kha drang ba'i ched du bkod pa yin gyis/

grub mtha' bzhi po gang gis kyang lugs ma yin gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig tshad 'bras gsum pa 'di grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po gang gis kyang lugs ma yin par/ phyogs glang yab sras kyi dngos stobs kyi rigs pas bzhag pa yin no// zhes 'dod pa dang*/ yang kha cig tshad 'bras gsum pa ni phyi don gzhal byar byed pas sems tsam pa'i lugs min la/ dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur bshad pas bye brag smra dang ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i lugs kyang ma yin pas/ mdo sde pa kho na'i lugs su grub gsung ba dang*/ mkhas pa kha cig 'bras rtogs gnyis pa'i tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa gcod byed yin pas sems tsam pa kho (616) na'i lugs yin gsungs pa dang*/ kha cig 'di ma dpyad pa'i tshe mdo sde pa dang*/ ma dpyad pa'i tshe sems tsam pa'i tshad 'bras yin no// zhes bzhed pa dang lnga 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs don bshad pa ni/ sde bdun rab gsal las/ gzhung gi skabs dang gzhal bya yang sgra dang*// tshad ma 'bras bu dpyad dang ma dpyad dang*// yid ches lung las mdo sems gnyis ka la// 'bras rtogs tshul 'di 'thad pa kho bos mthong*// zhes pa'i don bshad na/ 'di mdo sde pa kho na'i lugs yin na/ tshad 'bras dang po rdzogs mtshams nyid du 'byung rigs pa las der ma byung*/ sems tsam pa kho na'i lugs yin na/ rang rig ces ni rab tu bshad ces pa'i 'og tu 'byung rigs pa las der yang ma byung bar/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi phyi don gzhal bya la don rig 'bras bu dang*/ rnam rig pa'i lugs kyi gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bu dang*/ de'i lugs kyi tha snyad du phyi don gzhal bya la tha snyad du don rig 'bras bur byas pa'i tshad 'bras dang gsum bshad zin pa'i rjes su 'di byung bas/ gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bu yin par ma zad/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi phyi don gzhal bya dang*/ (617) rnam rig pa'i lugs kyi tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar byas pa gnyis po la yang dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur rigs pa yin no// zhes pa mdo sems gnyis ka'i tshad 'bras la dogs pa dpyad pas gsum pa'i gzhung gi skabs 'di mdo sems gnyis ka'i gzhung du grub pa ni shes byed kyi don tshan dang po yin la/

de bzhin du mdo sde pa'i lugs la phyi don lkog na mo gzhal bya dang*/ rnam rig pa'i lugs la tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar 'thad pa'i tshul sngar bshad zin pa ltar gzhal bya gnyis ka la sbyar ba ni don tshan gnyis pa/ mdo sde pa la sbyar ba'i tshe gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig 'bras bur ma zad phyi don gzhal bya la yang zhes dang*/ rnam rig pa la sbyar ba'i tshe rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe phyi don med mod/ tha snyad du phyi don yod na yang zhes yang sgra'i nus pa gnyis ka la sbyor ba don tshan gsum pa/ de bzhin du mdo sde pas phyi don lkog na mo gzhal byar byas pa'i tshe des bzhag pa'i gzung rnam tshad mar 'dod/ rnam rig pas tha snyad du phyi don gzhal byar byas pa'i tshe tha snyad du don rig gi 'jog byed du gyur pa'i don gyi rnam pa can gyi gzung rnam tshad mar 'dod pas/ tshad ma gnyis ka (618) la sbyar ba don tshan bzhi pa/ de bzhin du/ mdo sde pa'i phyi don gzhal byar byas pa'i tshe tshul gnyis grub par 'dod cing tshul gnyis sgrub byed kyi rigs pas dpyad na rang rig 'bras bu yin pa dang*/ rnam rig pa la yang gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med pas dpyad na rang rig 'bras bu yin pa las 'os med pa'i phyir na/ dpyad na rang rig 'bras bu gnyis ka sbyar ba ni don tshan lnga pa/ de bzhin du/ dbang shes la rang dus su sngon por snang ba sogs ma dpyad na phyi don yin pa dang*/ dpyad na shes pa rang gi ngo bor 'dod pa mdo sems gnyis ka mthun pas dpyad ma dpyad gnyis ka la sbyar ba ni don tshan drug pa/ de bzhin du/ gzhung nyid las/ de dang 'dra ba'am gzhan 'dra'ang rung*/ zhes phyi don gyis rang ngos nas rang 'dra mdo sde pa'i lugs/ gzhan bag chags kyi dbang gis 'dra ba sems tsam pa'i lugs kyang gsungs pa dang*/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ nyan thos sde gnyis dang sems tsam rnam bden brdzun gyi tshad 'bras bzhi bshad zin nas/

de ltar grub mtha' bzhi las/ slob dpon ni phyi rol gyi don khas len pa na mdo sde pa ltar (619) mdzad la/ shes bya nang la 'jug pa na rnam med zhal gyis bzhes so// gnyis ka ltar yang don dam rang rig gi tshad 'bras yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ rang gi ngo bo dpyod pa na/ rang rig 'bras bu yin par bshad// ces gsungs pas so// tha snyad kun rdzob tu mdo sde pa ltar don rig gi tshad 'bras yin te/ don 'jog de yi bdag nyid phyir// rang rig yin yang don rig 'dod// ces gsungs la/ gang ltar yang blo tshul gnyis pa yin te/ don rig ltar na yang*/ phyi rol don la brten nas ni// tshul gnyis brjod yin ces gsungs pas don shes pa dang*/ blo shes pa'i tshul gnyis yin la/ rnam rig ltar na phyi rol don ltos ma yin no// de phyir gcig la tshul gnyis yod// ces gsungs pas/ blo gcig la ma rig pas bslad pa'i yul dang shes pa'i tshul gnyis yin no// kho bo cag kyang chos kyi grags pa'i tshul 'di'i rjes su 'brang ngo*// bod phal cher bye brag tu smra ba'i rjes su 'brang mod/ de ni dngos po stobs zhugs kyis rigs pa ma shes par zad do// zhes gsungs pas mdo sems gnyis ka la sbyar ba gsal bar bstan la/ de ltar na yid ches kyi lung las 'bras rtogs gsum pa mdo (620) sems gnyis ka la sbyar ba ni shes byed kyi don tshan bdun pa'o// gzhan du na gnyis ka ltar yang don dam rang rig gi tshad 'bras yin pa'i shes byed du/ rang gi ngo bo dpyod pa na zhes sogs drangs pa don med par 'gyur te/ rang rig 'bras bu yin par bshad ces pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan gyi 'bras bu don gcig pa gang zhig de'i nang tshan gyi 'bras bu de khyed ltar na mdo sems gang rung gcig las gnyis ka'i lugs la sbyar du med pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs dang po grub te/ rang nyid nyams myong 'bras yin rigs// zhes pa'i 'bras bu dang*/

tshad 'bras gsum pa'i tshad 'bras kyi nang tshan gyi 'bras bu don gcig pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ tshad 'bras gsum par 'bras bu dngos su ston byed med par thal lo// des na tshad 'bras gsum pa'i 'bras bu tha snyad du don rig yin yang dpyad na rang rig yin pa mdo sems gnyis ka la sbyar du yod pa gsum pa'i gzhung nyid shes byed du mdzad de/ sgrub par mdzad pa rang 'grel du dngos su gsal ba 'di yin la/ 'bras bu'i 'gros kyis tshad 'bras gsum pa'i tshad ma dang (621) gzhal bya yang*/ mdo sems gnyis ka la so sor sbyar du yod pa rigs pas 'grub cing*/ gzhung nyid las kyang*/ de dang 'dra'am gzhan 'dra'ang rung*// zhes mdo sems gnyis ka'i tshad ma rim bzhin gsungs pas na/ kun mkhyen bla mas tshad 'bras gsum pa mdo sems gnyis ka la sbyar ba'i bshad srol 'di ni/ phyogs glang chos grags sa skya paṇa chen gsum ka dgongs pa phyogs gcig pa'i 'grel tshul bla na ma mchis pa/ 'gran zla kun bral gyi legs bshad du yid ches kyi lung rigs dang bcas te rtsod med du gsal ba 'di yin pas/ kun mkhyen chen po'i lta grub khyad par can gyi rjes zhugs mtha' dag kyang bskal pa bzang bar shes par bya'o// tha snyad kun rdzob tu mdo sde pa ltar zhes mdo sde pa dper mdzad pas sems tsam pas lugs su grub bo zhe na/ de ni tshig la 'khris pa tsam yin gyis dgongs pa ni tha snyad du mdo sde pa dang mthun par gnyis ka'i lugs la don rig 'bras bur sgrub par mdzad pa yin te/ de'i rjes thogs kho nar/ don 'jog de yi zhes sogs drangs pas kyang rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ dper na gnyis ka ltar yang zhes sogs kyi rgyab rten du rang gi

(622) ngo bo zhes sogs drangs pa 'di gnyis mtshungs pa yin no// mdor na tshad 'bras gsum pa mdo sems phyogs re ba smra ba rnams la drangs ma thag pa'i rang 'grel gyi tshig de dag la don dang mthun pa'i 'chad tshul gsung rgyu med ste/ 'di mdo sems phyogs re ba kho na yin na/ gnyis ka ltar yang zhes pa'i tshig dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ rang gi ngo bo spyod pa na zhes sogs kyang mdo sems gnyis kyi nang nas gang rung gcig kho na'i gzhung du thal bar 'gyur bas so// gzhan yang 'di'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag sngar don rig smra ba rang rang gi zhes pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i mdo sems gang rung gi tshad 'bras su 'dus par thal/ tshad 'bras mdo sems gang rung phyogs re ba gcig gi lugs su grub pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ bye mdo gnyis sems tsam rnam bden brdzun dang bzhi'i tshad 'bras bshad zin pas rjes su/ gnyis ka ltar yang zhes sogs tshad 'bras gsum pa'i gzhung dang sbyar ba 'di dag 'byung mi rigs par thal te/ sngar bshad pa'i mdo sems gang rung gi tshad 'bras su 'dus pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyod rang yang tshad 'bras gsum pa mdo sems gnyis ka la (623) sbyar du yod par sgrub nas/ mtshan gzhi so sor 'dzin pas na sngar bshad pa'i mdo sems gang rung gi tshad 'bras su 'dus dgos so zhe na/ mtshan gzhi so sor 'dzin kyang sngar gyi der 'dus mi dgos te/ 'di sngar gyi de la slar dogs pa dpyod byed kyi tshad 'bras yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sngar gyi de ni slar 'bras bu la dogs pa dpyod dgos pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i tshad 'bras yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ sde bdun rab gsal las kyang*/ don rigs gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa bcad na rang rig 'bras bur bstan zhes gsungs so// 'di rang gzhan kun gyi go dgos te/ dogs pa dpyod byed dang*/ dogs pa dpyod pa'i gzhi gnyis so sor ma 'dres pa gal che bas so// gnad kyi don ni/

tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ phyi don lkog na mo dang*/ tha snyad du phyi don gang rung gzhal bya la dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur byed pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab te/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ phyi don yod kyang rang rig 'bras bur sgrub// ces pa'i rdo rje'i tshig bka' stsal pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa mtshan gzhi ngos (624) bzung ba ni/ kun mkhyen gyi sde bdun rab gsal dang*/ mus chen gyi sde bdun nyi 'od gnyis ka las/ 'o na skabs 'di'i tshad 'bras ji lta bu zhe na/ sngar gyi don rig gi tshad 'bras gnyis kyi gzhal bya dang tshad ma gzhir byas nas 'bras bu'i skabs su tha snyad du phyi don sngon po rig pa yin yang dpyad na rang gi ngo bo rig pa'i mngon sum 'bras bu zhes sbyar ba nyid do// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi mtshan gzhi 'dzin pa na/ 'bras rtogs dang po'i gzhal bya dang tshad ma gzhir bzhag la/ 'bras bu'i tshe dpyad na rang rig dang tha snyad du don rig bsnan/ sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi mtshan gzhi 'dzin pa na/ tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras kyi gzhal bya dang tshad ma gzhir bzhag la/ 'bras bu'i tshe dpyad na rang rig bsnan pa yin no// de yang so sor dper brjod na/ sngon po lkog na mo gzhal bya/ gzung don can gyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon bzung don sngon po'i stobs las sngon po'i rnam ldan du skyes pa tshad ma/ gzung don can gyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis tha snyad du sngon po rtogs pa yin yang dpyad na rang gi bdag nyid rig pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag de/ tshad 'bras gsum (625) pa'i dngos bstan gyi mad sde pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ tha snyad du sngon po gzhal bya/ bag chags brtan byung gi sngor snang dbang shes la sngon po'i rnam pa shar ba tshad ma/ des tha snyad du sngon po rtogs pa yin yang dpyad na rang gi bdag nyid rig pa'i 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ni/

tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin zhing*/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin na mdo sems thun mong du khas mi len pas khyab te/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi ngos 'dzin la mdo sems gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par re re yod pa'i phyir te/ sde bdun rab gsal las/ dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras 'di mdo sems gnyis ka'i lugs su grub bo// 'on kyang phyi don gzhal byar 'jog tshul la khyad par yod cing*/ de'i stobs kyis gzung rnam la yang khyad par yod pas/ rang rig gi myong bya la yang khyad par yod pa ni sngar bshad zin cing*/ da dung yang 'chad par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di ni mkhan chen 'jam dpal (626) dbyangs dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i zhal gyi padmo las byung ba'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dog pa kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi dgongs pa phul du phyin pa yin no// 'di las gzhan du smra ba dag la blo gros dang ldan pa dag bag zon mdzod cig de ltar na mdo sems thun mong du byas te/ grub mtha'i rnam gzhag skyong ba rnam pa kun tu med pas/ tshad 'bras gsum pa 'dir yang rigs pas rtsod pa na/ mdo sems gang rung gcig la zhugs nas/ dgag sgrub kyi rtsod pa rtsod lan byed dgos la/ de'i tshe mdo sde pa la zhugs na tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin na/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab/ de'i dngos bstan sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin na/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan ma yin pas khyab/ spyir tshad 'bras gsum pa sems tsam pa'i lugs la yang sbyar nas 'chad pa'i lugs yod ces khas blang bar bya/ yang sems tsam pa la zhugs pa'i skabs yin na/ de las bzlog ste/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi tshad

(627) 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin na/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pas khyab/ ces sogs khas blang ma 'chugs pa bskyangs par bya'o// gal te kho na re/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin na/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin dgos par thal/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i gzhung 'di tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ston byed kyi rang gzhung rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ yang de'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ mdo sems thun mong du khas len pas khyab par thal/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i gzhung 'di mdo sems thun mong ba'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ 'o na tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag yin na/ tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin dgos par thal ba dang*/ de'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin na/ mdo sems thun mong du khas len pas khyab par thal/ rtags sngar ltar rim bzhin de'i phyir/ dang po la/ 'dod na/ mdo sde pa'i skabs yin na tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan dang bzhi pa'i dngos bstan tshad 'bras (628) kyi rnam gzhag gi mtshan gzhi rnams rtsod gzhir gzung nas 'phen/ thal ba gnyis pa la 'dod na/ mdo sems gang gi skabs yin kyang rung*/ sngon po lkog na mo gzhal bya/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon la de'i rang ngos nas gtad pa'i rnam pa shar ba tsam tshad ma/ des de rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ tshad 'bras dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ tshad 'bras dang po'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan zhig ngos 'dzin rigs pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ de chos can/ mdo sems thun mong du khas mi len par thal/ khyod sems tsam pas khas mi len pa'i phyir/

de bzhin du/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i dngos bstan sogs kyi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag mtshan gzhi rnams kyang rtsod gzhir bzung nas 'phen no// 'di dag kyang yongs 'dzin mchog gi zhal rgyun no// 'o na 'bras rtogs gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi 'bras bu 'di rang rig kho (629) nar nges sam don rig kyang yod ce na/ 'di skabs 'dir dpyod dgos pa'i dogs par snang bas dpyad par bya ste/ sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi 'bras bu de ni/ sems tsam pa'i lugs la rang rig kho nar nges te/ sems tsam pas/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi mngon sum yin na/ rang rig mngon sum yin pas khyab pa khas len pa'i phyir/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi 'bras bu de ni dpyad na rang rig ces bsnan kyang don rig mngon sum du khas len dgos pa yin te/ mdo sde pas dpyad na rang rig yin na/ rang rig yin pas ma khyab la/ tha snyad du don rig yin na/ don rig yin pas khyab pa khas len pa'i phyir/ rigs lam du gsal bar brjod na/ tshur mthong gi sngon 'dzin dbang mngon gyis tha snyad du sngon po rtogs pa yin yang dpyad na rang gi bdag nyid rig pa chos can/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi rang rig mngon sum ma yin par thal/ rang gi rig bya rang dang rdzas gcig kho na rig pa'i mngon sum ma yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi gzhal byar gyur pa'i phyi don yod pa'i phyir te/ khyod phyi don lkog na mo gzhal byar byed (630) pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'thad ldan gyi tshad 'bras gzhal gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ shes rab yod na de tsam gyi go bar 'gyur ro// 'di dag kyang yongs 'dzin mchog gi zhal rgyun las thos pa yin no// //des na tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras 'di ni sngar tshad 'bras dang po bkod zin pa'i rgol pa la/ slar dogs dpyod kyi tshul du bkod pa yin te/

dbang yid kyi mngon sum gyis don rang mtshan rtogs par mi 'dod pa'i rgol ba la tshad 'bras dang po bkod pas rgol ba des dbang yid kyi mngon sum gyis don rang mtshan rtogs par nges te/ dpyad pa'i tshe'ang don rang mtshan rtogs pa yin nam snyam pa na de'i ngor tshad 'bras gsum pa 'di bkod pas sngar gyi the tshom sel te/ dpyad na rang gi bdag nyid rig par rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de bzhin du/ tshad 'bras gsum pa'i dngos bstan gyi sems tsam pa'i lugs kyi tshad 'bras 'di yang*/ tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i tha snyad don rig gi tshad 'bras bkod zin pa'i rgol ba la slar dogs dpyod kyi tshul du yin te/ (631) rgyu mtshan sngar ltar ro// de ltar byas na kun mkhyen chen pos/ don rig gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa bcad nas dpyad na rang rig 'bras bur bstan zhes gsungs pa de'i dgongs pa 'khrul med du go nus pa yin no// phyi don gzhal byar yod kyang yin lugs la// dpyad na rang rig 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag ni// tshad 'bras gsum pa'i bstan don snying po yin// rang rig 'bras bu yin yang tshad ma ni// gzung rnam nyid yin 'di yi khyad chos yin// sngon chad bod 'dir tshad 'bras gsum pa la// rang rang blo yis 'grel tshul mang byung kyang*// phal cher chos grags dges pa'i lam du min// 'gran zla kun bral 'jam mgon sa skya pas// mdo sems gnyis kar dpyad na rang rig dang*// tha snyad don rig 'bras bur ston byed du// gsungs kyang rang rang rmongs pas sgrib pa bzhin// (632) (633) (634) (635) (636) (637) de la rang rig btags pa 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di rnam bden rdzun gnyis kyi nang nas rnam rdzun pas thun mong ma yin par khas len pa'i tshad 'bras gnyis kyi rnam gzhag yin zhing*/ de yang gzung 'dzin rig gsum tshad 'bras gzhal gsum du bzhag pa'i tshad 'bras yin te/ 'di'i gzhal bya ni gzung rnam/

tshad ma ni 'dzin rnam/ 'bras bu ni rang rig tu gsal ba'i phyir dang*/ rang 'grel las gzung ba 'dzin pa rig pa dag /ces sogs drangs pa de yang*/ rnam bden brdzun gnyis ka'i lung du drangs pa yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i gzhal bya dang tshad 'bras gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad yin te/ 'di'i gzhal bya ni sgro btags yin pas dngos med dang*/ tshad ma dang 'bras bu ni shes pa yin pas dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na 'di'i 'bras bu spyir rang rig mtshan nyid pa yin kyang*/ rang gi gzhal bya gzung rnam sgro btags pa la rang rig btags pa ba yin te/ bzung rnam sgro btags pa de rang gi rig bya don gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ sa bcad las/ rnam pa rdzun pas de la rang rig min// zhes gsungs so// lugs (638) 'di la tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi rang rig mngon sum gyi rig byar gyur pa'i spyi mtshan khas len dgos te/ de yin na/ rang gi rig bya rang dang rdzas gcig kho na rig pas ma khyab pa yin no// rnam bden pas bzung rnam yin na/ shes pa yin pas khyab/ gzung rnam bden grub tu 'dod/ rnam rdzun pas gzung rnam shes par mi 'dod par dngos med du 'dod pas gzung rnam dang*/ bzung rnam la ltos pa'i 'dzin rnam dang*/ rang rig rnams kyang bden med du gtan la phab nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal bden par grub cing*/ de grub pas de la bltos pa'i 'dzin rnam dang*/ rang rig kyang bden grub yin te/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa las/ bzung dang 'dzin pa las grol ba'i// rnam shes dam pa'i don du yod// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho yi// pha rol phyin rnams de skad sgrog /ces gsungs pa'i de sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i 'dod pa ston byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzung rnam gzhal bya la rang rig mtshan nyid pa'i tshad 'bras ni/ tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi shes pa rang gi bdag nyid gzhal bya/

de nyams su myong ba 'dzin rnam (639) tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di rang gi gzhal bya la rang rig mtshan nyid pa'i tshad 'bras yin te/ 'das tshad ma dang 'bras bu shes pa rang gi bdag nyid rdzas gcig tu byas nas rig pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ rnam 'grel las/ de yi bdag nyid phyir bdag rig /de phyir de lta'i sgrub byed yin// zhes dang*/ sa bcad las kyang*/ bdag nyid 'jal tshe rang rig 'bras bur grub// ces gsungs so// des mtshon nas tshor ba bde ba gzhal bya/ de nyams su myong ba'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes sogs tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi shes pa kun la rigs 'gre ba ni bye brag smra ba ma gtogs nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba kun mthun te/ rigs gter las/ de la rang rig tshad 'bras ni// rnam dag grub mtha' phal cher mthun// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ rnam 'grel las/ dper na 'dod chags sogs myong bzhin// rang bdag yul du bzhag pa na// gzhal bya 'jal byed 'bras gnas pa// 'di ni kun la sbyar bar bya// zhes pa'i tshigs bcad (640) lung du 'dren par mdzad pa dang*/ kun mkhyen chen pos kyang*/ rang rig tshad 'bras shes pa kun la sbyar// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam brdzun pas thun mong ma yin pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras ngos 'dzin na gzung rnam dang de la ltos pa'i 'dzin rnam gnyis ka bden pas stong pa'i shes pa rang rig rang gsal bden grub pa gzhal bya/ de nyams su myong ba'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma/ de nyams su myong ba'i rang rig 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di yin te/ bzung rnam dang de la ltos pa'i 'dzin rnam bden pas stong pas/ mdo sde pa dang*/ rnam bden pa gcod/ rang rig gis bye brag smra ba gcod/ bden grub ces pas ngo bo nyid med par smra ba gcod pa'i phyir/ mdor na tshad 'bras bzhi pa 'di/

thog mar rnam bden rdzun thun mong du sngar gyi tshad 'bras gnyis pa'i rang rig gi tshad 'bras la dogs pa dpyad ste/ gzung 'dzin rig gsum don la tha dad du med pa bstan/ de nas rnam brdzun pas khyad par bzung rnam bden med du sgrub te/ rnam bden pa las khyad par du 'phags pa bstan/ de nas rang rig khas len gyi

(641) nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba kun mthun par tshur mthong gi rgyud kyi shes pa kun la/ shes pa rang gi bdag nyid gzhal bya/ de nyams su myong ba'i 'dzin rnam tshad ma zhes sogs kyi rang rig gi tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag grub par bstan pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ de ltar rung nyid de tshad bdag /gzhal bya rang rig 'bras bu yin// zhes dang*/ rnam bshad kun bzang las/ rnam pa rdzun yang rang rig 'bras bur sgrub// ces dang*/ sde bdun rab gsal las/ rnam rig tshad 'bras la dogs pa bcad nas rang rig mtshan nyid pa'i tshad 'bras ngos bzung zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// //tshad 'bras gnyis par gzung 'dzin rig gsum la// tshad 'bras gzhal gsum bzhag pa 'khrul pa'i ngor// ji ltar snang bzhin gyi rnam gzhag yin// don la gzung 'dzin rig gsum dbyer med du// khas len rnam bden rnam rdzun gnyis ka mthun// gzhan du rnam bden rnam rdzun lung sbyor du// skabs 'di'i gzhung gi tshigs bcad drangs pa yis// 'jam dbyangs gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang 'grel 'di// sngon chad rnam dpyod lce yi ma myong ngam// sgro btags gzhal bya sogs kyi tshad (642) 'bras 'dis// 'bras bu rang rig rang gi gzhal bya la// rang rig min pas de la rang rig pa// btags pa ba yin don la rang rig ste// gzhal bya dngos med tshad 'bras dngos po yis// gcig bkag tha dad gsungs pa'i nus pa myong*// gzhan du rang rig min na blo rigs gang*// rnam rdzun gzung rnam rig pas bden bkag nas// bzung 'dzin gnyis med rang rig rang gsal 'dod// de nyid gzhal bya de yi 'dzin rnam sogs// tshad ma 'bras bu gnyis yin tshad 'bras ni// gzhal bya nyid la rang rig tshad 'bras yin// des na gzhal bya la ltos rang rig ni// btags pa ba dang mtshan nyid gnyis su grub// rang rig mtshan nyid tshad 'bras phal cher mthun// tshad 'bras bzhi pa bstan zin to// //gsum pa zhar byung rjes dpag gi tshad 'bras ni/

mdo sde pa ltar na la dang me'i tshogs don gzhal bya/ du ba'i rtags las la dang me'i tshogs don rtogs pa'i zhen rig gi blo tshad ma/ de'i rtags las de rtogs pa'i rjes dpag 'bras bu zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di yin te/ me'i rang mtshan gzhal bya la// du ba las byung gzhan sel blo// tshad ma nyid yin de rtogs pa// 'bras bu yin (643) zhes mkhas rnams bzhed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir la dang me'i tshogs don la gzhan sel gyi sgras bstan pa ni/ sgra yi don la rang mtshan du// 'khrul pa sgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi yin// zhes pa ltar song tshad la dgongs pas/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi gzhan sel gyis gzhan sel gyis gzhan sel go mi chod/ song tshod la gzhan sel yin na/ gzhan sel yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ byas pa'i rtags kyi sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags chos don gsum ka yang song tshod la gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa ltar na phyi rol gyi don med pas/ sa bon las myu gu dang*/ me las du ba skye ba sogs kyang khas mi len la/ de bas na lar snang dang mer snang gi tshogs don gzhal bya/ dur snang gi rtags las tshogs don de rtogs pa'i zhen rig gi blo tshad ma/ de'i rtags las de rtogs pa'i rjes dpag 'bras bu/ zhes pa'i tshad 'bras kyi rnam gzhag 'di yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ de la'ang du bar snang ba'i blos// bag chags gsal bar gsad pa can// mer snang ba yi blo nyid ni// rtogs 'gyur zhes dang*/ 'dir yang mer snang bag chags snying po las// du bar snang ba'i (644) bag chags skye// des na skyes bu mi bslu ba// rjes dpag yin zhes mkhas rnams bzhed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ blo gros gsal ba'i nyin byed 'od 'phreng gi /rmad byung rigs lam byed ba gsal byed pa'i// mkhas pa'i legs byas yid bzhin phung po ni// dpyod ldan kun gyi yid 'phrog srid na mtshar// 'jam dbyangs ngo bo kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi// legs par gsungs pa'i dgongs don rigs pa'i gter// gangs ri'i grong 'dir phyogs glang grags pa'i gzhung*// ma nor 'chad la shing rta'i srol 'byed yin// de slad bskal bar ldan pa'i mkhas pa ni// bye ba grangs kyi mtha' mi mngon pa yis// 'dir rjes zhugs nas rtog ge'i gnas tshul bzhin// rtogs nas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ches mthor bzung*// khyad par gzhung 'di'i dgongs don zla med pa// sngon bsags rnam dpyod bsod nams phul phyin mthus// ji bzhin rtogs nas tshul bzhin 'doms pa la// kun mkhyen bla ma las lhag srid 'dir su// bdag kyang mgon de'i rjes zhugs gus pa yis// 'jam dbyangs gzhung gi dgongs don lta ba la// brtson pa gnyis kyis sgo gsum sgrim byas pa'i// rnam dkar bya bas

(645) dal ba don chen ldan// de lta ma nor dam pa'i chos kyi dpyid// tshad ldan gong ma'i legs bshad pha mtha' yas// ngom par 'thung pa'i dge legs mchod pa'i sprin// kun bzang rnam 'phrul phung po bzhin bsam nas// yab gcig rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid// 'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs bla ma rje// bka' drin 'khor med dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i// 'dren byed lam du 'di 'bul brtse bas bzhes// de ltar phul bas 'dren mchog bla ma yis// thugs kyi dges pa chen pos nyer bzhes te// thugs rje'i gzigs pa bdag dang 'gro kun la// myur ba nyid du zhugs te ci bsam smon// gzhan yang 'dis mtshon dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// gcig tu sdom pa'i rnam dkar phung po yis// mkha' mnyam don du rnam mkhyen myur thob cing*// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bdag ni nam yang sgo gsum bya ba kun// dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin rgyun// mi nub 'phel ba kho na'i ched cig las// rang don zhi bde'i bsam pa gar yang ci// de phyir lhag bsam mi dman snying stobs kyis// sgrub dang sun 'byin rigs pa'i gzhung lugs (646) la// legs sbyangs tshul dang tshul min 'byed pa'i blos// tshad mar gyur pa'i bstan la byi dor sgrubs// rgyal ba'i chos tshul gces par bzung ba la// ma rung blun pos lan brgyar 'di brnyes yang*// bzod pa'i ting 'dzin ngang du blo bzhag nas// rang nyid bden pa'i nags tshal don gnyer min// bdag ni mtho dman 'byor rgud ci 'dra yang*// dkon mchog gsum la re ltos rtse gcig dang*// 'phral dang yun gyi sgo gsum bya byed kun// gzhan gyi don phyir dmigs so gzhan phan smon// rang nyid gsung rab zab mor blo sbyangs pas// thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon skyon med par// thob par nus dang rgyal bstan yun du ni// rgyas par 'gyur ro grogs dag skal ba bzang*// de ltar sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs don ma lus pa phyogs gcig tu gsal bar byed pa tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi blo rigs kyi skabs rab byed dang po dgu'i mtha' dpyod gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa'i legs par bshad pa 'di ni rigs gter rtsa ba rang 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/

de'i dgongs 'grel chen po tshad ma rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu'i glegs bam (647) gcig gyur kun mkhyen bla ma chen po'i sde bdun rab gsal la gtso bor gzhi brten/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen mi pham chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dpal dang paṇa chen rin po che mkhas pa'i dbang po shākya mchog ldan dang*/ rang cag gi 'dren pa rgyal ba mus rab 'byams pa byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang po rnams kyi mdzad pa'i rigs gter ṭikka so so dang*/ glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rigs gter gyi 'grel bshad chen mo/ rig pa ma lus pa la 'jug pa'i sgo rnams nas kyang*/ legs bshad kyi tshogs ji snyed bslangs nas kha rgyan/ yongs 'dzin bla ma'i gsung gi zab gnad khyad par can rnams kyang seb tshags su bkod ste mtha' chod par byas nas/ yongs 'dzin dam pa bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag mkhan chen rin po che dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad mo la yun ring du gtugs pa'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas/ lcags mo (648) phag gi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi nyin rgya dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor la thub bstan yangs pa can gyi bla brang gi dbang khang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa chos 'phel rgya mtshos mgyogs par bgyis pa yul dus phyogs dang gnas skabs kun tu bshad bsgrub kyi bstan pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i mchog dam par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// zhus dag/ // 1$0000220༈ /bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las gu rus spel// //1$0000270
